WITH school_sat_excellence AS (
  SELECT cds, 
         CAST(NumGE1500 AS FLOAT) / NumTstTakr AS excellence_rate
  FROM satscores
  WHERE NumTstTakr > 0
),
schools_with_sat_excellence AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM schools s
  JOIN school_sat_excellence e ON s.CDSCode = e.cds
  WHERE e.excellence_rate > 0.3
)
SELECT MAX(CAST(SOC AS FLOAT)) AS max_ages_5_17_free_meal_eligibility_rate
FROM schools_with_sat_excellence;

WITH AdminSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
)
SELECT frpm.[District Code], frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)]
FROM frpm
JOIN AdminSchools ON frpm.CDSCode = AdminSchools.CDSCode;

WITH charter_schools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE CharterNum = '756'
  AND MailCity = 'San Diego'
), school_sat AS (
  SELECT cs.CDSCode, COALESCE(SUM(ss.NumTstTakr), 0) AS total_takers
  FROM charter_schools cs
  LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON cs.CDSCode = ss.cds
  GROUP BY cs.CDSCode
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_takers), 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers
FROM school_sat;

WITH SchoolInfo AS (
  SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.GSserved AS grades_served,
    s.CDSCode AS cds_code
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'O' -- currently operating
    AND instr(s.GSserved, '12') > 0 -- includes grade 12 served
),

SatParticipation AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    COALESCE(SUM(ss.NumTstTakr), 0) AS sat_takers
  FROM schools s
  LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
  WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
  GROUP BY s.CDSCode
),

SchoolsWithNoSatTakers AS (
  SELECT
    si.school_name,
    si.grades_served
  FROM SchoolInfo si
  JOIN SatParticipation sp ON si.cds_code = sp.CDSCode
  WHERE sp.sat_takers = 0
),

GradeRank AS (
  SELECT
    school_name,
    grades_served,
    CASE
      WHEN grades_served LIKE 'P%' THEN 0
      WHEN grades_served LIKE 'K%' THEN 1
      WHEN grades_served LIKE '1%' THEN 2
      WHEN grades_served LIKE '2%' THEN 3
      WHEN grades_served LIKE '3%' THEN 4
      WHEN grades_served LIKE '4%' THEN 5
      WHEN grades_served LIKE '5%' THEN 6
      WHEN grades_served LIKE '6%' THEN 7
      WHEN grades_served LIKE '7%' THEN 8
      WHEN grades_served LIKE '8%' THEN 9
      WHEN grades_served LIKE '9%' THEN 10
      ELSE 100
    END AS lowest_grade_served
  FROM SchoolsWithNoSatTakers
)

SELECT school_name, grades_served
FROM GradeRank
WHERE lowest_grade_served = (SELECT MIN(lowest_grade_served) FROM GradeRank)
ORDER BY school_name
LIMIT 1000;
SELECT City FROM schools WHERE CDSCode = '01611920113902' AND County = 'Alameda' AND GSoffered = '9-12' LIMIT 1;

WITH StatewideCharterSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, Phone
  FROM schools
  WHERE Charter = 1
), HighSATSchools AS (
  SELECT cds, NumGE1500
  FROM satscores
)
SELECT s.School AS name, s.Phone AS phone
FROM StatewideCharterSchools s
JOIN HighSATSchools hs ON s.CDSCode = hs.cds
WHERE hs.NumGE1500 = (
  SELECT MAX(NumGE1500)
  FROM satscores
  WHERE NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY s.School;

WITH target_school AS (
    SELECT NumTstTakr
    FROM satscores
    WHERE cds = '7618040730051'
),
county_schools AS (
    SELECT satscores.cds, satscores.NumTstTakr
    FROM satscores
    JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE schools.County = 'Contra Costa'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS schools_ahead
FROM county_schools, target_school
WHERE county_schools.NumTstTakr > target_school.NumTstTakr;

WITH sf_public_schools AS (
  SELECT sc.CDSCode
  FROM schools sc
  JOIN satscores sat ON sc.CDSCode = sat.cds
  WHERE sc.MailCity = 'San Francisco'
    AND sc.FundingType = 'Public'
    AND sc.District IN ('Unified School District', 'High School District', 'Elementary School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
  GROUP BY sc.CDSCode
  HAVING AVG(COALESCE(sat.AvgScrRead,0) + COALESCE(sat.AvgScrMath,0) + COALESCE(sat.AvgScrWrite,0)) >= 1500
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_school_count
FROM sf_public_schools;

WITH grades AS (
  SELECT GSserved FROM schools WHERE NCESDist = '0632640' AND GSserved IS NOT NULL
), parsed AS (
  SELECT GSserved,
         CASE 
           WHEN GSserved LIKE 'K-%' THEN 0
           WHEN GSserved LIKE '%-%' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(GSserved, 1, INSTR(GSserved, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER)
          ELSE NULL
         END AS low_grade_num
  FROM grades
)
SELECT MIN(low_grade_num) AS lowest_grade_level_numeric
FROM parsed;

SELECT School AS school_name, EILName AS educational_instruction_level_name 
FROM schools 
WHERE CDSCode = '1612590136051' 
LIMIT 1;

WITH StateBoardSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, AdmEmail1
  FROM schools
  WHERE DOC = 'State Board of Education' OR DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
),
QualifiedScores AS (
  SELECT cds, NumGE1500
  FROM satscores
  WHERE NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
),
StateBoardHighScores AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode AS cds, s.School, s.AdmEmail1, COALESCE(q.NumGE1500, 0) AS count
  FROM StateBoardSchools s
  LEFT JOIN QualifiedScores q ON s.CDSCode = q.cds
)

SELECT School, AdmEmail1
FROM StateBoardHighScores
WHERE count = (SELECT MAX(count) FROM StateBoardHighScores)
AND count > 0;

WITH MiddleSchools AS (
  SELECT School, DOCType AS "School Type", Latitude
  FROM schools
  WHERE ((DOCType LIKE '%middle%' OR DOCType LIKE '%junior%')
     OR (School LIKE '%Middle%' OR School LIKE '%Junior%'))
    AND State = 'CA'
)
SELECT School AS "School Name", "School Type", Latitude
FROM MiddleSchools
WHERE Latitude = (SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM MiddleSchools)

WITH frpm_with_cds AS (
  SELECT *, 
    printf('%s%02d%03s', [County Code], [District Code], [School Code]) AS CDSCodeKey
  FROM frpm
  WHERE [Charter School (Y/N)] = 1
    AND [Charter Funding Type] IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
), active_coe_charters AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, FundingType
  FROM schools
  WHERE Charter = 1
    AND DOCType = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
    AND StatusType = 'Active'
    AND FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
)
SELECT 
  s.FundingType,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS num_currently_operating_schools,
  COALESCE(SUM(f.[Enrollment (K-12)]), 0) AS total_k_12_enrollment,
  COALESCE(SUM(f.[FRPM Count (K-12)]), 0) AS total_frpm_eligible_k_12_students
FROM active_coe_charters s
LEFT JOIN frpm_with_cds f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCodeKey
GROUP BY s.FundingType
ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

WITH ClosedSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, District, County
  FROM schools
  WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
), ClosedSchoolScores AS (
  SELECT s.sname, s.dname, s.cname, s.AvgScrWrite
  FROM satscores s
  JOIN ClosedSchools c ON s.cds = c.CDSCode
  WHERE s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
), RankedScores AS (
  SELECT 
    sname, dname, cname, AvgScrWrite,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS score_rank
  FROM ClosedSchoolScores
)
SELECT sname AS name, dname AS district, cname AS county, AvgScrWrite AS avg_writing_score
FROM RankedScores
WHERE score_rank = 2;

WITH OpenHighSchools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE StatusType = 'Active'
      AND GSserved = 'High School'
      AND State = 'CA'
      AND FundingType = '01'  -- public schools
),
SatCounts AS (
    SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) as total_sat_takers
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_sat_schools_count
FROM OpenHighSchools o
LEFT JOIN SatCounts s ON o.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.total_sat_takers IS NULL OR s.total_sat_takers = 0;

WITH monthly_openings AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', OpenDate) AS year_month,
    COUNT(*) AS schools_opened
  FROM schools
  WHERE strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'
    AND County = 'San Diego'
    AND District IS NOT NULL AND District != ''
  GROUP BY year_month
), all_months AS (
  SELECT '1980-01' AS year_month UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-02' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-03' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-04' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-05' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-06' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-07' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-08' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-09' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-10' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-11' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-12'
)
SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(COALESCE(schools_opened, 0)) AS FLOAT)/12 AS average_schools_per_month
FROM all_months am
LEFT JOIN monthly_openings mo ON am.year_month = mo.year_month;

WITH SchoolMaxFreeMealRate AS (
  SELECT
    s.School AS SchName,
    s.GSserved,
    CASE WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
         WHEN s.Charter = 0 THEN 'No'
         ELSE 'Unknown' END AS CharterStatus,
    fr.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] AS Free_Meal_Rate,
    s.CDSCode
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm fr ON s.CDSCode = fr.CDSCode
  WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
    AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12%' -- serves up to 12th grade
    AND fr.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] IS NOT NULL
),
MaxFreeMealRate AS (
  SELECT MAX(Free_Meal_Rate) AS MaxRate
  FROM SchoolMaxFreeMealRate
),
SchoolsWithMaxFreeMeal AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM SchoolMaxFreeMealRate
  WHERE Free_Meal_Rate = (SELECT MaxRate FROM MaxFreeMealRate)
),
SatPerformance AS (
  SELECT
    cds AS CDSCode,
    CASE
      WHEN AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite)/3 < 1050 THEN 'Below Average'
      WHEN AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite)/3 BETWEEN 1050 AND 1300 THEN 'Average'
      WHEN AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite)/3 > 1300 THEN 'Above Average'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS SAT_Performance
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
)

SELECT
  swmfm.SchName,
  ROUND(swmfm.Free_Meal_Rate/100.0, 4) AS Free_Meal_Rate,
  swmfm.CharterStatus,
  swmfm.GSserved AS Grades_Served,
  COALESCE(sp.SAT_Performance, 'No SAT Data') AS SAT_Performance
FROM SchoolsWithMaxFreeMeal swmfm
LEFT JOIN SatPerformance sp ON swmfm.CDSCode = sp.CDSCode
ORDER BY swmfm.SchName;

WITH numeric_grades AS (
  SELECT
    frpm.CDSCode,
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)",
    frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)",
    frpm."High Grade",
    CASE
      WHEN frpm."High Grade" = 'K' THEN 0
      WHEN frpm."High Grade" GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(frpm."High Grade" AS INTEGER)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS high_grade_num
  FROM frpm
  WHERE frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
    AND frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
    AND frpm."High Grade" IS NOT NULL
),

filtered_schools AS (
  SELECT
    ng.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.Street
  FROM numeric_grades ng
  JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = ng.CDSCode
  WHERE (ng."Enrollment (K-12)" - ng."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30
    AND ng.high_grade_num <= 8
)

SELECT School AS school_name, Street AS street_address
FROM filtered_schools
LIMIT 1000;

WITH school_enrollment AS (
  SELECT
    frpm.CDSCode AS CDSCode,
    frpm."School Name" AS SchoolName,
    schools.Street AS Street,
    CAST(frpm."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) AS LowGrade,
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS EnrollmentK12,
    frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS EnrollmentAges517
  FROM frpm
  JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
  WHERE CAST(frpm."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) >= 9
)
SELECT
  SchoolName,
  Street
FROM school_enrollment
WHERE (EnrollmentK12 - EnrollmentAges517) > 30
ORDER BY CDSCode ASC;

WITH high_free_meal_schools AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT [County Name] AS county, CDSCode AS cds
  FROM frpm
  WHERE [Academic Year] = '2014-15' AND [Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)] > 0.1
),
high_sat_schools AS (
  SELECT cds
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'overall' AND NumGE1500 >= 1
),
qualifying_schools AS (
  SELECT hf.county, hf.cds
  FROM high_free_meal_schools hf
  JOIN high_sat_schools hs ON hf.cds = hs.cds
)
SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM qualifying_schools
GROUP BY county
HAVING num_schools > 0
ORDER BY num_schools DESC, county ASC;

WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT
        cds AS school_code,
        CAST(NumGE1500 AS FLOAT) / NumTstTakr AS sat_excellence_rate
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumTstTakr >= 700
),
ranked_schools AS (
    SELECT
        school_code,
        sat_excellence_rate,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sat_excellence_rate ASC, school_code ASC) AS rank
    FROM eligible_schools
)
SELECT
    schools.Street AS street,
    schools.City AS city,
    schools.Zip AS zip,
    schools.State AS state
FROM ranked_schools
JOIN schools ON ranked_schools.school_code = schools.CDSCode
WHERE ranked_schools.rank = 1
LIMIT 1;

WITH MagnetSchoolsProvision2 AS (
    SELECT 
        s.City AS city,
        COUNT(*) AS provision_2_magnet_count
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Magnet = 1
      AND f.[NSLP Provision Status] = 'Provision 2'
    GROUP BY s.City
    HAVING provision_2_magnet_count > 0
)
SELECT city, provision_2_magnet_count
FROM MagnetSchoolsProvision2
ORDER BY provision_2_magnet_count DESC;

WITH Provision2_MagnetSchools AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.County, s.CDSCode
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f."School Code"
  WHERE s.State = 'CA'
    AND s.Magnet = 1
    AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = '2'
),
SAT_Takers_PerCounty AS (
  SELECT p.County, SUM(coalesce(ss.NumTstTakr,0)) AS total_sat_test_takers
  FROM Provision2_MagnetSchools p
  LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON p.CDSCode = ss.cds
  GROUP BY p.County
)
SELECT p.County, 
       COALESCE(t.total_sat_test_takers, 0) AS total_sat_test_takers
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT County FROM Provision2_MagnetSchools) p
LEFT JOIN SAT_Takers_PerCounty t ON p.County = t.County
ORDER BY p.County;

WITH cards_no_power AS (
    SELECT id, uuid
    FROM cards
    WHERE power IS NULL OR power LIKE '%*%'
),
rulings_triggered AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT uuid
    FROM rulings
    WHERE LOWER(text) LIKE '%triggered ability%'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS distinct_card_printings
FROM cards_no_power c
JOIN rulings_triggered r ON c.uuid = r.uuid;

WITH base_cards AS (
    SELECT 
        c.id,
        (SELECT COUNT(1) 
         FROM set_translations st 
         WHERE st.setCode = c.setCode AND st.language = 'fr' AND st.translation IS NOT NULL) > 0 AS has_french_translation
    FROM cards c
    WHERE c.power IS NULL OR c.power LIKE '%*%'
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN has_french_translation THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS french_translation_percentage
FROM base_cards;

WITH PromoCreatureCommanders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.name
    FROM cards c
    WHERE c.isPromo = 1
      AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
      AND c.leadershipSkills LIKE '%Brawl%'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM PromoCreatureCommanders;

WITH tarmogoyf_printings AS (
  SELECT setCode
  FROM cards
  WHERE LOWER(name) = 'tarmogoyf'
), frame_years AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.frameStyle, s.releaseDate
  FROM sets s
  JOIN tarmogoyf_printings t ON s.code = t.setCode
  WHERE s.frameStyle IS NOT NULL AND s.releaseDate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  CAST(strftime('%Y', MAX(releaseDate)) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', MIN(releaseDate)) AS INTEGER) AS year_span
FROM frame_years;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'black' AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10 AND isOnlineOnly = 1;

WITH distinct_translations AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(DISTINCT translation) AS translation_count
  FROM set_translations
  GROUP BY setCode
), filtered_sets AS (
  SELECT setCode
  FROM distinct_translations
  WHERE translation_count < 5
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cards
FROM cards
WHERE setCode IN (SELECT setCode FROM filtered_sets);

WITH card_id_list AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM cards
  WHERE name = "Mishra's Factory"
),
latest_ruling_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date
  FROM rulings
  WHERE uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM cards WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM card_id_list))
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings
WHERE uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM cards WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM card_id_list))
  AND date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_ruling_date);

WITH CreatureCards AS (
    SELECT id, artist
    FROM cards
    WHERE type LIKE '%Creature%'
),
ArtistCreatureCounts AS (
    SELECT artist, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS creature_count
    FROM CreatureCards
    GROUP BY artist
),
MaxCount AS (
    SELECT MAX(creature_count) AS max_creature_count
    FROM ArtistCreatureCounts
)
SELECT artist, creature_count
FROM ArtistCreatureCounts
WHERE creature_count = (SELECT max_creature_count FROM MaxCount);

WITH ZeroCMC_NewestFrame AS (
    SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS max_frame_version
    FROM cards
    WHERE convertedManaCost = 0
), NewestFrames AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT frameVersion
    FROM cards
    WHERE frameVersion = (SELECT max_frame_version FROM ZeroCMC_NewestFrame)
), FrameVersionCounts AS (
    SELECT frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM cards
    WHERE frameVersion IN (SELECT frameVersion FROM NewestFrames)
    GROUP BY frameVersion
)
SELECT frameVersion AS frame_version, card_count
FROM FrameVersionCounts
ORDER BY frameVersion DESC;

WITH goyf_printings AS (
  SELECT frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM cards
  WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  GROUP BY frameVersion
), total_printings AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) AS total FROM goyf_printings
), max_frame AS (
  SELECT frameVersion AS newest_frame FROM goyf_printings ORDER BY frameVersion DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  max_frame.newest_frame AS frame_version,
  ROUND(CAST(g.count AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / t.total, 2) AS percentage
FROM
  max_frame
  JOIN goyf_printings g ON g.frameVersion = max_frame.newest_frame
  JOIN total_printings t;

WITH zero_cost_cards AS (
  SELECT c.uuid
  FROM cards AS c
  WHERE c.manaCost = '{0}'
), legal_commander_cards AS (
  SELECT l.uuid
  FROM legalities l
  WHERE l.format = 'Commander' AND l.status = 'Legal'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT zc.uuid) AS zero_cost_legal_commander_card_count
FROM zero_cost_cards zc
JOIN legal_commander_cards lcc ON zc.uuid = lcc.uuid;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_cards_with_flying_and_cycling
FROM cards
WHERE keywords LIKE '%Flying%'
  AND keywords LIKE '%Cycling%';

WITH AbyssalHorrorSets AS (
  SELECT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate
  FROM sets s
  JOIN cards c ON s.code = c.setCode
  WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
),
EarliestSet AS (
  SELECT code, name, releaseDate
  FROM AbyssalHorrorSets
  WHERE (releaseDate, code) = (
    SELECT MIN(releaseDate), MIN(code)
    FROM AbyssalHorrorSets
    WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MIN(releaseDate) FROM AbyssalHorrorSets)
  )
),
LatestSet AS (
  SELECT code, name, releaseDate
  FROM sets
  WHERE (releaseDate, code) = (
    SELECT MAX(releaseDate), MIN(code)
    FROM sets
    WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MAX(releaseDate) FROM sets)
  )
),
TargetSets AS (
  SELECT * FROM EarliestSet
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM LatestSet
),
CardStats AS (
  SELECT 
    c.setCode,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cards,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.convertedManaCost <= 3 AND c.manaCost IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cheap_cards
  FROM cards c
  JOIN TargetSets ts ON c.setCode = ts.code
  GROUP BY c.setCode
)
SELECT
  ts.name AS set_name,
  ROUND(100.0 * cs.cheap_cards / cs.total_cards, 2) AS percent_cheap_mana_cost_cards
FROM TargetSets ts
JOIN CardStats cs ON ts.code = cs.setCode;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS release_promotion_card_count
FROM cards
WHERE promoTypes LIKE '%release%'
AND promoTypes NOT LIKE '%prerelease%'

WITH AbzanCards AS (
  SELECT c.name, c.number, c.setCode, c.uuid
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.watermark = 'abzan'
), MaxCollector AS (
  SELECT setCode, MAX(CAST(number AS INTEGER)) AS max_collector_number
  FROM AbzanCards
  GROUP BY setCode
), AbzanMaxCards AS (
  SELECT a.name, a.number, a.setCode, a.uuid
  FROM AbzanCards a
  JOIN MaxCollector m ON a.setCode = m.setCode AND CAST(a.number AS INTEGER) = m.max_collector_number
), ForeignPrintingsCount AS (
  SELECT fd.uuid, COUNT(*) AS foreign_count
  FROM foreign_data fd
  GROUP BY fd.uuid
)
SELECT amc.name, amc.number AS collector_number, IFNULL(fpc.foreign_count, 0) AS foreign_printings_count
FROM AbzanMaxCards amc
LEFT JOIN ForeignPrintingsCount fpc ON amc.uuid = fpc.uuid
ORDER BY amc.setCode, CAST(amc.number AS INTEGER);

WITH FlashCards AS (
  SELECT
    cards.name,
    cards.convertedManaCost AS cmc
  FROM
    cards
  JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
  WHERE
    sets.name = 'Dark Ascension'
    AND cards.keywords LIKE '%Flash%'
)
SELECT name
FROM FlashCards
WHERE cmc = (SELECT MAX(cmc) FROM FlashCards)
ORDER BY name ASC;

WITH sets_2020 AS (
  SELECT code, name, keyruneCode
  FROM sets
  WHERE strftime('%Y', releaseDate) = '2020'
)

SELECT s.name, s.keyruneCode as keyrune_code, COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS language_count
FROM sets_2020 s
LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
GROUP BY s.name, s.keyruneCode
ORDER BY s.name;

WITH localized_sets AS (
  SELECT s.code
  FROM sets s
  JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
  WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
    AND st.language != 'English'
  GROUP BY s.code
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cards
FROM cards
WHERE setCode IN (SELECT code FROM localized_sets);

WITH filtered_cards AS (
  SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM cards
  WHERE borderColor = 'black'
    AND mtgArenaId IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10
  GROUP BY artist
), max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(card_count) AS max_card_count FROM filtered_cards
)
SELECT artist, card_count
FROM filtered_cards, max_count
WHERE card_count = max_card_count
ORDER BY artist;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE hasContentWarning = 1 AND hasNonFoil = 1 AND mtgoId IS NULL;

WITH expansion_types AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT type FROM sets
),

japanese_name_counts AS (
  SELECT
    s.type AS expansion_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.code) AS japanese_name_count
  FROM sets s
  JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
  WHERE st.language = 'ja' AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.type
)

SELECT
  et.type AS expansion_type,
  COALESCE(jnc.japanese_name_count, 0) AS japanese_name_count
FROM expansion_types et
LEFT JOIN japanese_name_counts jnc ON et.type = jnc.expansion_type

WITH arena_black_power_5_or_more AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT artist
    FROM cards

      AND mtgArenaId IS NOT NULL
      AND mtgoId IS NULL
      AND power NOT LIKE '%*%'
      AND power NOT LIKE '%+%'
      AND power NOT LIKE '%-%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT artist) AS num_artists
FROM arena_black_power_5_or_more;

WITH ancestor_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.code, s.releaseDate
  FROM sets s
  JOIN cards c ON s.code = c.setCode
  WHERE c.name = "Ancestor's Chosen"
), latest_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(releaseDate) AS max_date
  FROM ancestor_sets
), latest_sets AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM ancestor_sets, latest_date
  WHERE releaseDate = max_date
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS creature_count
FROM cards
WHERE setCode IN (SELECT code FROM latest_sets)
  AND type LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND power IS NOT NULL
  AND toughness IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) > CAST(toughness AS INTEGER);

WITH FoilCards AS (
  SELECT name
  FROM cards
  WHERE hasFoil = 1
),
NonFoilCards AS (
  SELECT name
  FROM cards
  WHERE hasNonFoil = 1
),
CommanderLeadableCards AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM cards
  WHERE leadershipSkills LIKE '%Commander%'
),
BothFoilAndNonFoilCommanderCards AS (
  SELECT c.name, c.frameVersion
  FROM CommanderLeadableCards c
  WHERE c.name IN (SELECT name FROM FoilCards)
    AND c.name IN (SELECT name FROM NonFoilCards)
),
FrameYearParsed AS (
  SELECT name, frameVersion, 
    CASE
      WHEN frameVersion = '1997' THEN 1997
      WHEN frameVersion = '1998' THEN 1998
      WHEN frameVersion = '2003' THEN 2003
      WHEN frameVersion = '2015' THEN 2015
      WHEN frameVersion = '2019' THEN 2019
      ELSE NULL
    END as frame_year
  FROM BothFoilAndNonFoilCommanderCards
  WHERE frameVersion IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  frame_year, 
  COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM FrameYearParsed
WHERE frame_year IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY frame_year
ORDER BY frame_year DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH CreatureElves AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT scryfallOracleId, name, uuid
  FROM cards
  WHERE originalType LIKE '%Creature - Elf%'
),
RulingsCount AS (
  SELECT CreatureElves.name, COUNT(rulings.id) AS rulings_count
  FROM rulings
  JOIN CreatureElves ON rulings.uuid = CreatureElves.uuid
  GROUP BY CreatureElves.scryfallOracleId, CreatureElves.name
),
MaxRulings AS (
  SELECT MAX(rulings_count) AS max_count
  FROM RulingsCount
)
SELECT rulings_count AS rulings, name
FROM RulingsCount, MaxRulings
WHERE rulings_count = max_count;

WITH card_colors AS (
  SELECT id, uuid, colors AS color
  FROM cards
  WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
), color_legality AS (
  SELECT c.color, l.format
  FROM card_colors c
  JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
  WHERE l.status = 'Legal'
)
SELECT color, COUNT(DISTINCT format) AS legal_formats_count
FROM color_legality
GROUP BY color;

WITH AvonFoilCards AS (
  SELECT cards.frameVersion
  FROM cards
  WHERE cards.artist = 'John Avon'
    AND cards.hasFoil = 1
    AND cards.frameVersion IS NOT NULL
), MaxYear AS (
  SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS recent_frame
  FROM AvonFoilCards
)
SELECT frameVersion AS frame_year, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM AvonFoilCards
GROUP BY frameVersion
HAVING frameVersion = (SELECT recent_frame FROM MaxYear)
;

WITH erica_yang_cards AS (
  SELECT uuid
  FROM cards
  WHERE artist = 'Erica Yang'
),
paper_printings AS (
  SELECT uuid
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
  WHERE s.isOnlineOnly = 0
),
pauper_legal_paper_printings AS (
  SELECT l.uuid
  FROM legalities l
  JOIN paper_printings p ON l.uuid = p.uuid
  WHERE l.format = 'pauper' AND l.status = 'legal'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pauper_erica_yang_printings_count
FROM pauper_legal_paper_printings pl
JOIN erica_yang_cards e ON pl.uuid = e.uuid;

SELECT
  cardKingdomFoilId,
  cardKingdomId
FROM cards
WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND types LIKE '%Creature%'
ORDER BY cardKingdomFoilId ASC, cardKingdomId ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH boros_foreign_cards AS (
  SELECT c.type
  FROM cards c
  JOIN foreign_data f ON c.name = f.name
  WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
), type_counts AS (
  SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM boros_foreign_cards
  GROUP BY type
), max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(count) AS max_count
  FROM type_counts
)
SELECT type, count
FROM type_counts, max_count
WHERE count = max_count;

WITH Guilds AS (
  SELECT 'azorius' AS guild
  UNION ALL SELECT 'boros'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'dimir'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'golgari'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'grul'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'izzet'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'orzhov'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'rakdos'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'selesnya'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'simic'
),
GuildCards AS (
  SELECT c.watermark, c.name, f.language
  FROM cards c
  JOIN foreign_data f ON c.id = f.id
  WHERE c.watermark IN (SELECT guild FROM Guilds)
),
CountByGuild AS (
  SELECT watermark AS guild, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS count
  FROM GuildCards
  WHERE language != 'English'
  GROUP BY watermark
),
MaxCount AS (
  SELECT MAX(count) AS max_count
  FROM CountByGuild
)
SELECT countbyguild.guild, countbyguild.count
FROM CountByGuild countbyguild
JOIN MaxCount ON countbyguild.count = MaxCount.max_count
ORDER BY countbyguild.guild;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE frameVersion >= '2015' AND text IS NOT NULL AND text != ''

WITH LatestFrameVersion AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS maxFrameVersionInt
  FROM cards
  WHERE frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
),
LatestFrameCards AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM cards
  WHERE CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) = (SELECT maxFrameVersionInt FROM LatestFrameVersion)
),
PromotionalMultiFaceCards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT name
  FROM LatestFrameCards
  WHERE isPromo = 1
    AND layout IN ('transform', 'modal_dfc', 'meld', 'split', 'flip', 'double_faced_token', 'aftermath', 'reversible_card')
)
SELECT name FROM PromotionalMultiFaceCards
LIMIT 1000;

WITH tarmogoyf_ids AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM cards
  WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
),
sets_with_tarmogoyf AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.name, s.releaseDate, c.frameVersion
  FROM sets s
  JOIN cards c ON s.code = c.setCode
  WHERE c.id IN (SELECT id FROM tarmogoyf_ids)
),
frame_ages AS (
  SELECT 
    name, 
    releaseDate, 
    frameVersion,
    CAST(SUBSTR(releaseDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) AS age
  FROM sets_with_tarmogoyf
  WHERE frameVersion IS NOT NULL
    AND frameVersion != ''
),
old_frame_sets AS (
  SELECT name, releaseDate
  FROM frame_ages
  WHERE age >= 10
)
SELECT name AS set_name, releaseDate
FROM old_frame_sets
ORDER BY releaseDate;

WITH european_sets AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM sets
  WHERE code IN (SELECT DISTINCT parentCode FROM sets WHERE parentCode IS NOT NULL) -- sets with parents (likely regional)
),
counterspell_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT setCode
  FROM cards
  WHERE name = 'Counterspell'
),
fr_it_sets AS (
  SELECT setCode
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE language IN ('fr', 'it')
  GROUP BY setCode
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT language) = 2
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT es.code)
FROM european_sets es
JOIN counterspell_sets cs ON es.code = cs.setCode
JOIN fr_it_sets fs ON es.code = fs.setCode;

WITH target_type AS (
  SELECT type
  FROM sets
  WHERE name = 'From the Vault: Lore'
),
sets_same_type AS (
  SELECT code, name, releaseDate
  FROM sets
  WHERE type IN (SELECT type FROM target_type)
),
sets_with_foreign_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT setCode
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE translation IS NOT NULL AND translation != ''
)
SELECT s.name, s.releaseDate
FROM sets_same_type s
LEFT JOIN sets_with_foreign_names swfn ON s.code = swfn.setCode
WHERE swfn.setCode IS NULL
ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC;

WITH card_printings AS (
  SELECT c.setCode, s.name AS set_name, s.releaseDate
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
  WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
), 
latest_frame AS (
  SELECT max(frameVersion) AS max_frame
  FROM cards
  WHERE name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
), 
printings_with_latest_frame AS (
  SELECT cp.set_name, cp.releaseDate
  FROM card_printings cp
  JOIN cards c ON cp.setCode = c.setCode
  JOIN latest_frame lf ON c.frameVersion = lf.max_frame
  WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
)
SELECT set_name, releaseDate
FROM printings_with_latest_frame
WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT max(releaseDate) FROM printings_with_latest_frame)
ORDER BY set_name;

WITH sets_2020 AS (
  SELECT code, releaseDate
  FROM sets
  WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
), sets_with_spanish_name AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT setCode
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE language = 'es'
)
SELECT s.code, s.releaseDate
FROM sets_2020 s
LEFT JOIN sets_with_spanish_name st ON s.code = st.setCode
WHERE st.setCode IS NULL
ORDER BY s.releaseDate;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(convertedManaCost), 0) AS total_converted_mana_cost
FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'Rob Alexander'
  AND originalReleaseDate BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31'
  AND originalReleaseDate IS NOT NULL;

WITH SetLanguages AS (
    SELECT
        s.code,
        COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS language_count
    FROM
        sets s
    LEFT JOIN
        set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
    WHERE
        s.releaseDate >= '2016-01-01' AND s.releaseDate < '2017-01-01'
    GROUP BY
        s.code
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(language_count), 2) AS avg_languages
FROM SetLanguages;

WITH jap_boros_cards AS (
  SELECT c.name AS name_jp, c.type AS type_eng, c.uuid, c.setCode
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
), jap_boros_jp_printings AS (
  SELECT jbc.name_jp, jbc.type_eng, jbc.uuid
  FROM jap_boros_cards jbc
  JOIN sets s ON s.code = jbc.setCode
  WHERE s.code = jbc.setCode AND s.isForeignOnly = 0
), ruling_counts AS (
  SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) AS rulings_num
  FROM rulings
  GROUP BY uuid
), aggregated_rulings AS (
  SELECT j.name_jp, j.type_eng, COALESCE(SUM(r.rulings_num), 0) AS total_rulings
  FROM jap_boros_jp_printings j
  LEFT JOIN ruling_counts r ON j.uuid = r.uuid
  GROUP BY j.name_jp, j.type_eng
)
SELECT name_jp, type_eng, total_rulings
FROM aggregated_rulings
ORDER BY total_rulings DESC, name_jp, type_eng
LIMIT 1000;

WITH
FlavorTextLanguages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    setCode,
    flavorText,
    length(flavorText) AS flavor_length
  FROM cards
  WHERE flavorText IS NOT NULL
),
SetTranslationsLanguages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT language
  FROM set_translations
),
FlavorCountByLanguage AS (
  SELECT
    st.language AS language,
    COUNT(c.id) AS flavor_translated_printings
  FROM cards c
  JOIN set_translations st ON c.setCode = st.setCode
  WHERE c.flavorText IS NOT NULL
    AND st.language IS NOT NULL
    AND st.language != ''
  GROUP BY st.language
),
AllLanguages AS (
  SELECT language FROM set_translations GROUP BY language
),
FlavorCountFull AS (
  SELECT
    l.language,
    COALESCE(fc.flavor_translated_printings, 0) AS flavor_translated_printings
  FROM AllLanguages l
  LEFT JOIN FlavorCountByLanguage fc ON l.language = fc.language
),
MinFlavorCount AS (
  SELECT MIN(flavor_translated_printings) AS min_count FROM FlavorCountFull
)
SELECT
  f.language AS language_name,
  f.flavor_translated_printings AS number_of_translated_flavor_printings
FROM FlavorCountFull f CROSS JOIN MinFlavorCount m
WHERE f.flavor_translated_printings = m.min_count
ORDER BY f.language ASC
;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS count
FROM cards c
JOIN set_translations st ON c.setCode = st.setCode
WHERE st.language = 'fr'
  AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'

WITH sets_mtgo AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM sets
  WHERE mtgoCode IS NOT NULL
), printings_2014 AS (

)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_printings

JOIN sets_mtgo s ON p.setCode = s.code;

WITH coldnap_set AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM sets
  WHERE name = 'Coldsnap'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.printings) AS italian_rules_printings_count
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE c.setCode = (SELECT code FROM coldnap_set)
  AND fd.language = 'Italian'
  AND fd.text IS NOT NULL;

WITH CommanderExpansionSets AS (
  SELECT id, name, code
  FROM sets
  WHERE type = 'commander' AND releaseDate >= '2020-01-01' AND releaseDate <= '2020-12-31'
),
CardCounts AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM cards
  WHERE setCode IN (SELECT code FROM CommanderExpansionSets) AND isPromo = 0
  GROUP BY setCode
),
TranslationCounts AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(DISTINCT language) AS lang_count
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE setCode IN (SELECT code FROM CommanderExpansionSets)
  GROUP BY setCode
),
SetTotals AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.name, 
         COALESCE(c.card_count, 0) AS card_count, 
         COALESCE(t.lang_count, 0) AS lang_count
  FROM CommanderExpansionSets s
  LEFT JOIN CardCounts c ON s.code = c.setCode
  LEFT JOIN TranslationCounts t ON s.code = t.setCode
),
MaxCardCount AS (
  SELECT MAX(card_count) AS max_count FROM SetTotals
)
SELECT id, name, lang_count
FROM SetTotals
WHERE card_count = (SELECT max_count FROM MaxCardCount)
ORDER BY id ASC;

WITH mono_black_artifacts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.name
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.colors = 'B' -- only black color
    AND c.types LIKE '%Artifact%'
), foreign_language_flavor AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.name
  FROM foreign_data f
  JOIN cards c ON c.name = f.name
  WHERE f.flavorText != '' -- has flavor text in foreign language
    AND f.flavorText IS NOT NULL
    AND c.colors = 'B'
    AND c.types LIKE '%Artifact%'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mba.name) AS count_mono_black_artifacts_with_foreign_flavor
FROM mono_black_artifacts mba
JOIN foreign_language_flavor flf ON mba.name = flf.name;

SELECT SUM(Reputation) AS total_uk_reputation
FROM users
WHERE Location LIKE '%United Kingdom%'
AND Id IN (SELECT DISTINCT OwnerUserId FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL);

WITH CommentLinks AS (
  SELECT c.userId
  FROM comments c
  WHERE c.text LIKE '%http://%' OR c.text LIKE '%https://%'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG((JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(u.creationDate)) / 365.25), 2) AS avg_age_years
FROM users u
JOIN CommentLinks cl ON u.id = cl.userId;

WITH OrganizerBadge AS (
  SELECT UserId, MIN(Date) AS OrganizerAwardedAt
  FROM badges
  WHERE Name = 'Organizer'
  GROUP BY UserId
),
GermanOrganizerUsers AS (
  SELECT u.Id AS UserId, o.OrganizerAwardedAt
  FROM users u
  JOIN OrganizerBadge o ON u.Id = o.UserId
  WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
),
CountEarlierBadges AS (
  SELECT b.UserId, COUNT(*) AS EarlyBadgeCount
  FROM badges b
  JOIN GermanOrganizerUsers g ON b.UserId = g.UserId
  WHERE b.Date < g.OrganizerAwardedAt
    AND b.Name != 'Organizer'
  GROUP BY b.UserId
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS SeasonedCount
FROM CountEarlierBadges
WHERE EarlyBadgeCount >= 5;

WITH FirstPosts AS (
  SELECT OwnerUserId, MIN(CreaionDate) AS FirstPostDate
  FROM posts
  WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY OwnerUserId
), UsersFirstPost2010 AS (
  SELECT OwnerUserId
  FROM FirstPosts
  WHERE FirstPostDate >= '2010-01-01' AND FirstPostDate < '2011-01-01'
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS UsersCountInIndia
FROM users u
JOIN UsersFirstPost2010 f ON u.Id = f.OwnerUserId
WHERE u.Location = 'India';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.reputation)) AS avg_reputation
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%' AND p.Score < 20;

WITH GermanyUsers AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM users
  WHERE location LIKE '%Germany%'
), Posts2012 AS (
  SELECT id, LastEditorUserId, Score
  FROM posts
  WHERE strftime('%Y', CreaionDate) = '2012'
),
GermanyEditedPosts AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.Score
  FROM Posts2012 p
  JOIN GermanyUsers g ON p.LastEditorUserId = g.id
),
OtherEditedPosts AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.Score
  FROM Posts2012 p
  LEFT JOIN GermanyUsers g ON p.LastEditorUserId = g.id
  WHERE g.id IS NULL
),
GermanyEditors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.reputation
  FROM users u
  JOIN Posts2012 p ON u.id = p.LastEditorUserId
  WHERE u.location LIKE '%Germany%'
)

SELECT 
  (SELECT SUM(Score) FROM GermanyEditedPosts) AS total_score_germany_last_editor,
  (SELECT SUM(Score) FROM OtherEditedPosts) AS total_score_non_germany_last_editor,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GermanyEditors) AS germany_based_last_editors,
  (SELECT SUM(reputation) FROM GermanyEditors) AS combined_reputation_germany_editors
;

WITH R_posts AS (
  SELECT Id, OwnerUserId
  FROM posts
  WHERE Tags LIKE '%<R>%'
),
LastActive_R_P_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT OwnerUserId
  FROM posts
  WHERE date(LasActivityDate) = '2014-08-27'
    AND OwnerUserId IN (SELECT OwnerUserId FROM R_posts)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(u.Reputation), 0) AS combined_reputation
FROM users u
WHERE u.Id IN (SELECT OwnerUserId FROM LastActive_R_P_users)

WITH TargetQuestion AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM posts
    WHERE Title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'
),
LinkedQuestions AS (
    SELECT pl.PostId AS question_id
    FROM postLinks pl
    JOIN TargetQuestion tq ON pl.RelatedPostId = tq.Id
    WHERE pl.LinkTypeId = 1
)

SELECT SUM(p.Score) AS total_score
FROM posts p
JOIN LinkedQuestions lq ON p.Id = lq.question_id
WHERE p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'

WITH UserBadgeCounts AS (
  SELECT u.Id AS UserId, u.DisplayName, COUNT(b.Id) AS BadgeCount
  FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
  WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
  GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
),
MaxBadgeCount AS (
  SELECT MAX(BadgeCount) AS MaxCount FROM UserBadgeCounts
),
SecondMaxBadgeCount AS (
  SELECT MAX(BadgeCount) AS SecondMaxCount
  FROM UserBadgeCounts
  WHERE BadgeCount < (SELECT MaxCount FROM MaxBadgeCount)
)
SELECT DisplayName, BadgeCount
FROM UserBadgeCounts
WHERE BadgeCount = (SELECT SecondMaxCount FROM SecondMaxBadgeCount)
ORDER BY DisplayName;

SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation
FROM users
WHERE Location LIKE '%California%'
AND Views = (SELECT MAX(Views) FROM users WHERE Location LIKE '%California%')

WITH IndiaUsers AS (  
  SELECT Id  
  FROM users  
  WHERE Location LIKE '%India%'  
), YearlingBadge AS (  
  SELECT UserId  
  FROM badges  
  WHERE Name = 'Yearling' AND Date < '2014-01-01'  
)  
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) AS IndiaUsersWithYearlingBefore2014
FROM IndiaUsers u
JOIN YearlingBadge b ON u.Id = b.UserId;

WITH supporter_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT userId
  FROM badges
  WHERE name = 'Supporter'
), adult_supporters AS (
  SELECT u.id, u.displayName
  FROM users u
  JOIN supporter_users s ON u.id = s.userId
  WHERE u.age BETWEEN 19 AND 65
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT displayName) AS distinct_display_names
FROM adult_supporters;

WITH RelatedCounts AS (
    SELECT
        p.Id as PostId,
        p.Title,
        COUNT(pl.RelatedPostId) as RelatedCount
    FROM posts p
    LEFT JOIN postLinks pl ON pl.PostId = p.Id
    WHERE LOWER(p.Title) LIKE '%principal component scores%'
    GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title
), MaxCount AS (
    SELECT MAX(RelatedCount) as MaxRelatedCount FROM RelatedCounts
)
SELECT Title, RelatedCount
FROM RelatedCounts
WHERE RelatedCount = (SELECT MaxRelatedCount FROM MaxCount)
AND RelatedCount > 0
;

WITH bounty_offers AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(p.ownerUserId, p.ownerDisplayName) AS bounty_user,
    ph.PostId,
    ph.Text,
    ph.CreationDate
  FROM posts p
  JOIN postHistory ph ON p.Id = ph.PostId
  WHERE ph.PostHistoryTypeId = 8
    AND CAST(ph.Text AS INTEGER) >= 30
    AND ph.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
    AND ph.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bounty_user) AS user_count
FROM bounty_offers;

WITH user_post_counts AS (
  SELECT OwnerUserId, COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts
  WHERE strftime('%Y', CreaionDate) = '2012'
    AND OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY OwnerUserId
  HAVING post_count > 10
), upvote_counts AS (
  SELECT userId, COUNT(*) AS upvote_count
  FROM votes
  WHERE voteTypeId = 2 -- upvote
  GROUP BY userId
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(upvote_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_upvotes,
  ROUND(AVG(age), 2) AS avg_age
FROM user_post_counts
LEFT JOIN upvote_counts ON user_post_counts.OwnerUserId = upvote_counts.userId
JOIN users ON user_post_counts.OwnerUserId = users.Id;

WITH months AS (
  SELECT date('2010-01-01') AS month_start
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
  FROM months
  WHERE month_start < '2010-12-01'
),
posts_with_answers AS (
  SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.parentId,
         COUNT(a.id) AS answer_count
  FROM posts p
  LEFT JOIN posts a ON a.parentId = p.id
  WHERE p.postTypeId = 1
  GROUP BY p.id
  HAVING answer_count <= 2
),
links_in_month AS (
  SELECT
    pl.postId,
    strftime('%Y-%m', pl.creationDate) AS link_month
  FROM postLinks pl
  JOIN posts_with_answers pwa ON pl.postId = pwa.post_id
  WHERE pl.creationDate >= '2010-01-01' AND pl.creationDate < '2011-01-01'
),
monthly_linked_posts AS (
  SELECT link_month, COUNT(DISTINCT postId) AS posts_count
  FROM links_in_month
  GROUP BY link_month
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(posts_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_posts_per_month
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', month_start) AS month
  FROM months
) m
LEFT JOIN monthly_linked_posts mlp ON m.month = mlp.link_month

WITH Posts2010 AS (
  SELECT p.Id, p.OwnerUserId
  FROM posts p
  WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01' AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
    AND p.Score > 5
), HighRepUsers AS (
  SELECT Id
  FROM users
  WHERE Reputation >= 1000
), TotalPosts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalCount
  FROM Posts2010
), PostsNotByHighRep AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS NotByHighRepCount
  FROM Posts2010
  WHERE OwnerUserId NOT IN (SELECT Id FROM HighRepUsers)
)
SELECT ROUND(CAST(PostsNotByHighRep.NotByHighRepCount AS FLOAT) / TotalPosts.TotalCount * 100, 2) AS Percentage
FROM TotalPosts, PostsNotByHighRep;

WITH question_post AS (
    SELECT id 
    FROM posts 
    WHERE title LIKE 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
      AND posttypeid = 1
    LIMIT 1
), 
edit_counts AS (
    SELECT ph.userId, u.displayName, COUNT(*) AS edit_count
    FROM postHistory ph

), 
max_edit_count AS (

EligibleCustomers AS (

WITH czech_high_value_transactions AS (

WITH months_count AS (

frequent_customers AS (

customer_counts AS (

WITH czk_customers AS (

czk_avg AS (

eur_customers AS (

eur_avg AS (

WITH total_consumption AS (

WITH feb_transactions AS (

sme_customers AS (

JoinedData AS (

),
Matches_With_Fast_Buildup AS (
  SELECT hw.id, hw.home_team_api_id

Club_Win_Counts AS (

Max_Win_Count AS (

  SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match UNION ALL

SELECT Country.name

SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE date = '2015-01-01'
  AND preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium')

WITH LatestPlayerAttributes AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate, date
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE preferred_foot IS NOT NULL
      AND attacking_work_rate IS NOT NULL
), LatestDates AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM LatestPlayerAttributes

SELECT ROUND(

FROM LatestPlayerAttributes lpa

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes

WITH LastMatchDate AS (
    SELECT MAX(M.date) AS last_date, T.team_api_id
    FROM Match M
    JOIN Team T ON (M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id OR M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id)
    WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
      AND strftime('%Y', M.date) = '2012'
    GROUP BY T.team_api_id
),
BuildUpSnapshot AS (
    SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass, TA.team_api_id, TA.date AS snapshot_date
    FROM Team_Attributes TA
    JOIN LastMatchDate LMD ON TA.team_api_id = LMD.team_api_id
    WHERE TA.date <= LMD.last_date
)
SELECT buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM BuildUpSnapshot
WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM BuildUpSnapshot) LIMIT 1;

WITH MaxDatePerPlayer AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
  FROM Player_Attributes

),
DateRatings AS (

),
LandonDonovanRating AS (

  FROM Player p
  JOIN DateRatings dr ON p.player_api_id = dr.player_api_id
  WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'

),
AvgRating AS (

)
SELECT ROUND((LandonDonovanRating.overall_rating - AvgRating.avg_rating) / AvgRating.avg_rating * 100, 2) AS pct_higher
FROM LandonDonovanRating, AvgRating;

WITH RunningLoansDistricts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE l.status = 'running'
),
UnemploymentRates AS (
  SELECT district_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN A8 = 1995 THEN A10 ELSE NULL END) AS unemployment_1995,
         MAX(CASE WHEN A8 = 1996 THEN A10 ELSE NULL END) AS unemployment_1996
  FROM district
  WHERE A8 IN (1995, 1996)
  GROUP BY district_id
),
DistrictsWithChange AS (
  SELECT rd.district_id,
         ur.unemployment_1995,
         ur.unemployment_1996,
         ROUND(((ur.unemployment_1996 - ur.unemployment_1995) / ur.unemployment_1995) * 100, 2) AS pct_change_unemployment
  FROM RunningLoansDistricts rd
  JOIN UnemploymentRates ur ON rd.district_id = ur.district_id
  WHERE ur.unemployment_1995 IS NOT NULL AND ur.unemployment_1996 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.A2 AS district,
       dc.pct_change_unemployment
FROM DistrictsWithChange dc
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = dc.district_id
ORDER BY d.A2;

WITH first_month_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.district_id
    FROM account a
    WHERE a.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM account) 
      AND a.date < date((SELECT MIN(date) FROM account), '+1 month')
    GROUP BY a.district_id
), max_population AS (
    SELECT MAX(d.A8) AS max_pop
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM first_month_accounts)
)
SELECT d.district_id, d.A8 AS population
FROM district d
JOIN first_month_accounts fma ON d.district_id = fma.district_id
WHERE d.A8 = (SELECT max_pop FROM max_population);

WITH loan_repayment_status AS (
  SELECT 
    l.*, 
    date(l.date, '+' || (l.duration - 1) || ' days') AS last_repayment_date
  FROM loan l
  WHERE l.date <= '1995-12-31'
),
active_loans AS (
  SELECT 
    lr.*
  FROM loan_repayment_status lr
  WHERE lr.last_repayment_date >= '1995-12-31'
),
loan_regions AS (
  SELECT 
    al.amount,
    d.A2 AS region
  FROM active_loans al
  JOIN account a ON al.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    region, 
    SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM loan_regions
  GROUP BY region
),
max_total AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_amount) AS max_amount FROM region_totals
)
SELECT region, total_amount
FROM region_totals, max_total
WHERE total_amount = max_amount;

WITH older_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
), loans_per_account AS (
  SELECT la.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loans_count
  FROM older_accounts la
  LEFT JOIN loan l ON la.account_id = l.account_id
  GROUP BY la.account_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(loans_count), 2) AS avg_loans_per_account
FROM loans_per_account;

WITH MaleCohortClients AS (
  SELECT client_id
  FROM client
  WHERE gender = 'M' AND strftime('%Y', birth_date) IN ('1974', '1975', '1976')
),
CohortAccounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT disp.account_id
  FROM disp
  WHERE disp.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM MaleCohortClients)
),
RelevantPayments AS (
  SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, o.k_symbol
  FROM trans t
  LEFT JOIN "order" o ON t.trans_id = o.order_id
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM CohortAccounts)
    AND t.amount > 4000
    AND t.type = 'payment'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN k_symbol = 'household payment' THEN 1 END) AS household_payment_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND k_symbol != 'household payment' THEN 1 END) AS other_purpose_payment_count
FROM RelevantPayments;

WITH large_districts AS (
  SELECT district_id
  FROM district
  WHERE A9 >= 250000
),
gold_clients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
gold_accounts AS (
  SELECT d.account_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN gold_clients gc ON d.client_id = gc.client_id
  JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE a.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM large_districts)
),
gold_outgoing_payments AS (
  SELECT t.bank AS bank_to, t.account AS account_to, COUNT(*) AS num_payments, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    AND t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accounts)
    AND t.date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
),
max_total AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_amount) AS max_amount FROM gold_outgoing_payments
)
SELECT g.bank_to, g.account_to, g.num_payments, g.total_amount
FROM gold_outgoing_payments g
JOIN max_total m ON g.total_amount = m.max_amount
ORDER BY g.bank_to, g.account_to;

WITH card_clients AS (
  SELECT c.client_id, ca.type AS card_type
  FROM card ca
  JOIN disp d ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE ca.type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
district_inhabitants AS (
  SELECT cc.card_type, c.district_id, di.A14 AS inhabitants
  FROM card_clients cc
  JOIN client c ON cc.client_id = c.client_id
  JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
  GROUP BY cc.card_type, c.district_id
),
min_inhabitants_per_type AS (
  SELECT card_type, MIN(inhabitants) AS min_inhabitants
  FROM district_inhabitants
  GROUP BY card_type
)
SELECT di.card_type, di.district_id, di.inhabitants
FROM district_inhabitants di
JOIN min_inhabitants_per_type m ON di.card_type = m.card_type AND di.inhabitants = m.min_inhabitants
ORDER BY di.card_type, di.district_id
LIMIT 1000;

WITH litomerice_region AS (
  SELECT d.region
  FROM district d
  WHERE d.district_name = 'Litomerice'
  LIMIT 1
),
accounts_1996 AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.branch
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.branch = d.district_id
  JOIN litomerice_region lr ON d.region = lr.region
  WHERE strftime('%Y', a.open_date) = '1996'
),
last_1996_trans AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, t.trans_id, t.trans_date, t.amount
  FROM trans t
  JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, MAX(trans_date) AS max_date
    FROM trans
    WHERE trans_date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
  ) mt ON t.account_id = mt.account_id AND t.trans_date = mt.max_date
),
max_trans_ids AS (
  SELECT account_id, MAX(trans_id) AS max_trans_id
  FROM last_1996_trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
final_trans AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, t.amount
  FROM last_1996_trans t
  JOIN max_trans_ids mti ON t.account_id = mti.account_id AND t.trans_id = mti.max_trans_id
),
acc_balances AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, d.district_name, d.region, COALESCE(f.amount, 0) AS balance
  FROM accounts_1996 a
  JOIN district d ON a.branch = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN final_trans f ON a.account_id = f.account_id
),
district_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    district_name,
    COUNT(account_id) AS num_accounts,
    ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS avg_balance
  FROM acc_balances
  GROUP BY district_name
  HAVING COUNT(account_id) > 0
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS region_avg_balance
  FROM acc_balances
),
top_district AS (
  SELECT district_name, avg_balance
  FROM district_stats
  WHERE avg_balance = (SELECT MAX(avg_balance) FROM district_stats)
  ORDER BY district_name
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT district_name, num_accounts, avg_balance
FROM district_stats
ORDER BY district_name

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Region-wide average balance', NULL, region_avg_balance
FROM region_stats

UNION ALL

SELECT 'District with highest average balance: ' || district_name, NULL, avg_balance
FROM top_district
;

WITH district_withdrawals AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region, d.A8 AS population, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM district d
    JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE d.A8 >= 100000
      AND t.type = 'withdrawal'
    GROUP BY d.district_id
),
withdrawals_per_inhabitant AS (
    SELECT district_id, district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn,
           ROUND(CAST(total_withdrawn AS FLOAT) / population, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant
    FROM district_withdrawals
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT district_id, district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn, withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS rank_withdrawals_per_inhabitant
    FROM withdrawals_per_inhabitant
),
standing_order_avg AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, AVG(COALESCE(so.total_debit, 0)) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
    FROM account a
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_debit
        FROM trans
        WHERE type = 'standing-order'
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) so ON a.account_id = so.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
)
SELECT r.district_name, r.region, r.population, r.total_withdrawn, r.withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
       r.rank_withdrawals_per_inhabitant AS withdrawal_rank,
       ROUND(COALESCE(s.avg_standing_order_debit_per_account, 0), 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN standing_order_avg s ON r.district_id = s.district_id
ORDER BY r.withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC;

WITH accounts_in_region AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date, a.district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A3 LIKE '%Bohemia%'
      AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
),
loans_per_account AS (
    SELECT account_id, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', a.date) AS year_text,
        a.district_id,
        a.account_id,
        COALESCE(l.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM accounts_in_region a
    LEFT JOIN loans_per_account l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        year_text,
        district_id,
        COUNT(account_id) AS accounts_opened,
        SUM(total_loan_amount) AS total_lent
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY year_text, district_id
)
SELECT 
    agg.year_text AS account_open_year,
    SUM(agg.accounts_opened) AS num_accounts_opened,
    SUM(agg.total_lent) AS total_amount_lent,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(agg.total_lent AS FLOAT) / agg.accounts_opened), 2) AS avg_loan_per_account_per_district
FROM aggregated agg
GROUP BY agg.year_text
ORDER BY agg.year_text;

WITH filtered_loans AS (
  SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS approved_amount, l.date AS approval_date
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE l.duration = 24 AND a.frequency = 'W'
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.loan_id = l.loan_id) > 0
),
ranked_loans AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY approved_amount DESC, approval_date ASC) AS rn
  FROM filtered_loans
),
top_loans AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked_loans WHERE rn <= 10
),
lend_bal AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, t.date, t.trans_id, t.balance
  FROM trans t
),
loan_balance AS (
  SELECT tl.loan_id, tl.account_id, tl.approved_amount, tl.approval_date, lb.balance
  FROM top_loans tl
  JOIN lend_bal lb ON tl.account_id = lb.account_id AND tl.approval_date = lb.date
  WHERE lb.trans_id = (
    SELECT MAX(trans_id) FROM trans 
    WHERE account_id = tl.account_id AND date = tl.approval_date
  )
),
account_district AS (
  SELECT account_id, district_id FROM account
),
final AS (
  SELECT ad.district_id, lb.approved_amount, lb.approval_date, lb.balance AS account_balance
  FROM loan_balance lb
  JOIN account_district ad ON lb.account_id = ad.account_id
)
SELECT * FROM final
ORDER BY approved_amount DESC, approval_date ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH north_moravia_branches AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2 AS branch_name
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'north Moravia'
),
branch_transaction_counts AS (
    SELECT n.branch_name, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS no_char_transactions
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN north_moravia_branches n ON a.district_id = n.district_id
    WHERE t.date <= '1998-10-14'
      AND (t.type IS NULL OR t.type = '')
    GROUP BY n.branch_name
)
SELECT branch_name, no_char_transactions
FROM branch_transaction_counts
ORDER BY no_char_transactions DESC, branch_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH LoanApplicants AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE loan_id = 98832 AND date = '1996-01-03'
), OutgoingPayments AS (
  SELECT t.bank, t.account, COUNT(*) AS num_payments, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM trans t
  JOIN LoanApplicants la ON t.account_id = la.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date < '1996-01-03'
  GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
)
SELECT bank, account, num_payments, total_amount
FROM OutgoingPayments
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

WITH branch_accounts AS (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM account
  WHERE district_id = 1
    AND date <= DATE('1995-12-31')
), active_loans AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE status NOT IN ('A', 'B')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ba.account_id) AS active_account_count
FROM branch_accounts ba
JOIN active_loans al ON ba.account_id = al.account_id;

WITH client_accounts AS (
    SELECT acc.account_id
    FROM account acc
    JOIN disp d ON acc.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE d.client_id = 2823
),
interest_transactions AS (
    SELECT t.amount, t.type, t.k_symbol
    FROM trans t
    JOIN client_accounts ca ON t.account_id = ca.account_id
    WHERE date(t.date) BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
),
interest_credited AS (
    -- Interest credited might have k_symbol = 'INT' or type = 'C'
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_credited
    FROM interest_transactions
    WHERE amount > 0 AND (k_symbol = 'INT' OR type = 'C')
),
penalty_interest_charged AS (
    -- Penalty interest might have k_symbol = 'PNLT' or type = 'D'
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_penalty
    FROM interest_transactions
    WHERE amount < 0 AND (k_symbol = 'PNLT' OR type = 'D')
)
SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT total_credited FROM interest_credited), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT total_penalty FROM penalty_interest_charged), 0) AS net_interest_czk;

WITH older_female_clients AS (
  SELECT client.client_id, disp.account_id
  FROM client
  JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
  WHERE client.gender = 'F' AND client.birth_date < '1930-01-01'
), districts_for_clients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT account.district_id
  FROM older_female_clients
  JOIN account ON older_female_clients.account_id = account.account_id
), district_salaries AS (
  SELECT district.district_id, district.A10 AS district_avg_salary
  FROM districts_for_clients
  JOIN district ON districts_for_clients.district_id = district.district_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(district_avg_salary), 2) AS avg_district_salary
FROM district_salaries;

WITH RaceInfo2017 AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017
),
Old2000Races AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2000
),
Newer2017Races AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM RaceInfo2017
  WHERE raceId NOT IN (SELECT raceId FROM Old2000Races)
),
PitStopCounts AS (
  SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS pit_stop_count
  FROM pitStops
  WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM Newer2017Races)
  GROUP BY raceId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stop_count), 2) AS avg_pit_stops_per_race
FROM PitStopCounts;

WITH GermanDrivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname, dob, url
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'German' AND dob BETWEEN '1971-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
), Q3Counts AS (
    SELECT q.driverId, COUNT(*) AS q3_count
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN GermanDrivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE q.position <= 10
    GROUP BY q.driverId
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.url AS wikipedia_link, d.dob AS dateOfBirth, COALESCE(q.q3_count, 0) AS q3_times
FROM GermanDrivers d
LEFT JOIN Q3Counts q ON d.driverId = q.driverId
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC;

WITH race_info AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND year = 1995
),
qual_times AS (
  SELECT driverId, q1
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_info)
    AND q1 IS NOT NULL
),
slowest_time AS (
  SELECT MAX(q1) AS max_q1
  FROM qual_times
),
slowest_drivers AS (
  SELECT driverId, q1
  FROM qual_times
  WHERE q1 = (SELECT max_q1 FROM slowest_time)
)
SELECT d.driverRef AS short_name, d.nationality, d.dob AS birthday, sd.q1 AS q1_time
FROM slowest_drivers sd
JOIN drivers d ON sd.driverId = d.driverId;

WITH japanese_gp_1995 AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 1995 AND name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
), q1_times AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q1
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN japanese_gp_1995 jg ON q.raceId = jg.raceId
  WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL
), fastest_time AS (
  SELECT MIN(CAST(q1 AS FLOAT)) AS min_q1
  FROM q1_times
), fastest_drivers AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q1
  FROM q1_times q
  JOIN fastest_time ft ON CAST(q.q1 AS FLOAT) = ft.min_q1
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, fd.q1
FROM fastest_drivers fd
JOIN drivers d ON fd.driverId = d.driverId;

WITH di_grassi_qualifying AS (
    SELECT q.raceId, q.position AS di_grassi_position
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE d.forename = 'Lucas' AND d.surname = 'di Grassi' AND r.year = 2010
),
all_qualifications AS (
    SELECT q.raceId, q.driverId, q.position
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2010
)

SELECT SUM(outqualified_count) AS total_outqualified
FROM (
    SELECT dq.raceId, COUNT(aq.driverId) AS outqualified_count
    FROM di_grassi_qualifying dq
    JOIN all_qualifications aq ON dq.raceId = aq.raceId AND dq.di_grassi_position < aq.position
    GROUP BY dq.raceId
);

WITH race_2017_italy AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
q2_times AS (
  SELECT driverId, q2
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_2017_italy)
),
fastest_q2 AS (
  SELECT MIN(q2) AS best_q2_time
  FROM q2_times
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM q2_times q
JOIN fastest_q2 f ON q.q2 = f.best_q2_time
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId;

WITH Italian_Second_Places AS (
  SELECT d.forename
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND r.positionOrder = 2
)
SELECT forename, COUNT(*) AS runner_up_count
FROM Italian_Second_Places
GROUP BY forename
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY runner_up_count DESC, forename ASC;

WITH race_winner AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, res.driverId
  FROM races r
  JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
  WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix' AND res.positionOrder = 1
), finish_time AS (
  SELECT lt.milliseconds, lt.lap, lt.driverId, lt.raceId
  FROM lapTimes lt
  JOIN race_winner rw ON lt.driverId = rw.driverId AND lt.raceId = rw.raceId
  ORDER BY lt.milliseconds DESC
  LIMIT 1
), race_info AS (
  SELECT raceId, name, circuitId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
), circuit_info AS (
  SELECT circuitId, location, country, url
  FROM circuits
  WHERE circuitId = (SELECT circuitId FROM race_info)
), race_finish AS (
  SELECT rw.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, ci.url, ft.milliseconds
  FROM race_winner rw
  JOIN drivers d ON rw.driverId = d.driverId
  JOIN finish_time ft ON ft.driverId = d.driverId AND ft.raceId = rw.raceId
  JOIN circuit_info ci ON ci.circuitId = (SELECT circuitId FROM race_info)
)
SELECT 
  forename, 
  surname,
  time((milliseconds / 1000) / 3600, 'unixepoch') || substr(printf('.%03d', milliseconds % 1000), 2) AS local_time_at_finish,
  url AS circuit_url
FROM race_finish
LIMIT 1;

WITH Q2_drivers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT driverId
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix')
  AND q2 IS NOT NULL
),
Q3_drivers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT driverId
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix')
  AND q3 IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob
FROM Q2_drivers q2
JOIN drivers d ON q2.driverId = d.driverId
LEFT JOIN Q3_drivers q3 ON q2.driverId = q3.driverId
WHERE q3.driverId IS NULL
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH italian_gp_2017 AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND year = 2017
),
q2_times AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q2
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN italian_gp_2017 igp ON q.raceId = igp.raceId
  WHERE q.q2 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2 != ''
),
ranked_q2 AS (
  SELECT q2.driverId, CAST(REPLACE(q2.q2, ':', '') AS FLOAT) AS q2_seconds, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE(q2.q2, ':', '') AS FLOAT)) AS q2_rank
  FROM q2_times q2
),
second_fastest AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM ranked_q2
  WHERE q2_rank = 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM drivers d
JOIN second_fastest sf ON d.driverId = sf.driverId;

WITH max_pit_stop_duration AS (
  SELECT MAX(milliseconds) AS max_duration FROM pitStops
), longest_pit_stops AS (
  SELECT pitStops.*
  FROM pitStops
  JOIN max_pit_stop_duration ON pitStops.milliseconds = max_pit_stop_duration.max_duration
), pit_stop_with_race AS (
  SELECT longest_pit_stops.*, races.circuitId, races.year
  FROM longest_pit_stops
  JOIN races ON longest_pit_stops.raceId = races.raceId
), pit_stop_with_circuit AS (
  SELECT pit_stop_with_race.milliseconds, pit_stop_with_race.year, circuits.name AS circuit_name, circuits.location, circuits.country
  FROM pit_stop_with_race
  JOIN circuits ON pit_stop_with_race.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
)
SELECT circuit_name, location, country, year AS season_year, milliseconds AS pit_stop_length_milliseconds
FROM pit_stop_with_circuit
;

WITH Drivers1981to1991 AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM drivers
  WHERE dob BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1991-12-31'
),
DriverQ3Counts AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, COUNT(q.q3) AS q3_lap_count
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN Drivers1981to1991 d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY q.driverId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(q3_lap_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_q3_laps_per_driver
FROM (
  SELECT d.driverId, COALESCE(dc.q3_lap_count, 0) AS q3_lap_count
  FROM Drivers1981to1991 d
  LEFT JOIN DriverQ3Counts dc ON d.driverId = dc.driverId
) sub;

WITH FirstNamesWithoutCode AS (
  SELECT d.driverId, d.code, d.forename AS first_name
  FROM drivers d
  WHERE d.code IS NULL
),
FirstNameCounts AS (
  SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM FirstNamesWithoutCode
  GROUP BY first_name
  HAVING cnt > 1
),
TargetDrivers AS (
  SELECT d.driverId
  FROM FirstNamesWithoutCode d
  JOIN FirstNameCounts f ON d.first_name = f.first_name
),
Qualifying1Under2Minutes AS (
  SELECT q.driverId
  FROM qualifying q
  WHERE q.Q1 < 120000 -- times are in milliseconds
  AND q.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM TargetDrivers)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_qualifying1_under_2_minutes
FROM Qualifying1Under2Minutes;

WITH RobertDrivers AS (
  SELECT driverId, forename || ' ' || surname AS referenceName
  FROM drivers
  WHERE forename = 'Robert'
),
RacesWithLapData AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT driverId, raceId
  FROM lapTimes
),
RobertPoints AS (
  SELECT r.driverId, SUM(r.points) AS totalPoints
  FROM results r
  JOIN RobertDrivers rd ON r.driverId = rd.driverId
  JOIN RacesWithLapData rld ON r.driverId = rld.driverId AND r.raceId = rld.raceId
  GROUP BY r.driverId
)
SELECT rd.referenceName, COALESCE(rp.totalPoints, 0) AS totalPoints
FROM RobertDrivers rd
LEFT JOIN RobertPoints rp ON rd.driverId = rp.driverId
ORDER BY totalPoints DESC;

WITH filtered_races AS (
    SELECT raceId, date
    FROM races
    WHERE name = 'French Grand Prix' AND year >= 1990
),
lap_times_fastest_per_driver AS (
    SELECT raceId, driverId, MIN(milliseconds) AS fastest_ms
    FROM lapTimes
    WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM filtered_races)
    GROUP BY raceId, driverId
),
fastest_laps_over_90 AS (
    SELECT r.date, d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, l.fastest_ms
    FROM lap_times_fastest_per_driver l
    JOIN filtered_races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON l.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE l.fastest_ms > 90000
),
formatted_results AS (
    SELECT
      date,
      driverId,
      forename,
      surname,
      printf('%d:%06.3f', fastest_ms / 60000, (fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000.0) AS fastest_lap_time
    FROM fastest_laps_over_90
),
final_output AS (
    SELECT date, driverId, forename, surname, fastest_lap_time
    FROM formatted_results
)
SELECT
    fr.date,
    fo.forename,
    fo.surname,
    fo.fastest_lap_time
FROM filtered_races fr
LEFT JOIN final_output fo ON fr.date = fo.date
ORDER BY fr.date ASC, fo.surname ASC, fo.forename ASC
;

WITH ItalianQ3Times AS (
    SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q3
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId

),
FastestQ3 AS (

SELECT forename, surname, q3

WITH BritishDrivers AS (

    FROM drivers

),
BritishQualifying AS (

),
MinQ3Time AS (

),
FastestTimes AS (

ResultsWithNames AS (

)
SELECT full_name, race_name, race_year, Q3_time
FROM ResultsWithNames
ORDER BY Q3_time ASC;

WITH second_fastest_drivers AS (

WITH winning_drivers AS (

SELECT

WITH Fastest_Q3_times AS (

),
Fastest_overall AS (

),
Fastest_drivers AS (

SELECT DISTINCT nationality

WITH FastestLapConstructors AS (

SELECT

WITH australian_drivers AS (

),

races_with_good_aus_finish AS (

pit_stops_per_season AS (

WITH qual_1995 AS (

qual_q1_above_2min AS (

SELECT COUNT(*) AS drivers_above_2min

WITH September2016Races AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS race_name, r.circuitId, c.name AS circuit_name, c.location

    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId

    JOIN September2016Races sep ON pit.raceId = sep.raceId

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, fps.pit_stop_time, s.race_name, s.circuit_name, s.location

WHERE fps.pit_stop_time = (

WITH WinningDrivers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob, d.nationality
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
  WHERE r.positionOrder = 1
),
OldestWinningDriver AS (
  SELECT driverId, forename, surname, dob, nationality

  LIMIT 1
),
FirstWinRace AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, rc.name, rc.date
  FROM results r

  WHERE r.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM OldestWinningDriver) AND r.positionOrder = 1

),
TotalRacesStarted AS (
  SELECT driverId, COUNT(DISTINCT raceId) AS total_races
  FROM results
  WHERE driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM OldestWinningDriver)

)
SELECT o.forename || ' ' || o.surname AS full_name, o.nationality, f.name AS first_win_race_name, f.date AS first_win_race_date, t.total_races
FROM OldestWinningDriver o
JOIN FirstWinRace f ON 1=1
JOIN TotalRacesStarted t ON t.driverId = o.driverId;

WITH canadian_races AS (

), 
accident_status AS (

accident_retirements AS (

) 
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT raceId) AS runnings_with_accident_retirements

WITH Q2_times AS (
  SELECT
    q.driverId,
    q.constructorId,
    q.q2,
    r.grid
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races ra ON q.raceId = ra.raceId

),
Ranked_Q2 AS (
  SELECT
    q2.driverId,
    q2.constructorId,
    q2.q2,
    q2.grid,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY q2.q2 ASC, q2.grid ASC) AS rank

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name
FROM Ranked_Q2 r

WHERE r.rank = 2

WITH fastest_q2_times AS (

WITH season_race AS (

),
fastest_q3_time AS (

)
SELECT DISTINCT number
FROM qualifying
WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM season_race)
AND CAST(REPLACE(q3, ':', '') AS FLOAT) = (SELECT fastest_time FROM fastest_q3_time);

WITH ItalianGP AS (

), Q3Times AS (
  SELECT driverId, q3
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM ItalianGP) AND q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3 != ''
), FastestQ3Time AS (

)
SELECT d.code AS driver_code, f.q3 AS fastest_q3_time

WITH FastestQ3 AS (
  SELECT raceId, MIN(Q3) AS FastestQ3Time

),
Race2017Italy AS (

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying q
JOIN FastestQ3 fq ON q.raceId = fq.raceId AND q.Q3 = fq.FastestQ3Time

WITH chinese_gp_races AS (
  SELECT raceId, year, time
  FROM races

),
min_start_time AS (
  SELECT year, MIN(time) AS min_time
  FROM chinese_gp_races
  WHERE time IS NOT NULL

),
earliest_year AS (
  SELECT MAX(year) AS year, min_time
  FROM min_start_time
  GROUP BY min_time
  ORDER BY min_time
  LIMIT 1
),
er_id AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM chinese_gp_races
  WHERE year = (SELECT year FROM earliest_year) AND time = (SELECT min_time FROM earliest_year)
),
runner_up AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.time
  FROM results r
  WHERE r.position = 2 AND r.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM er_id)
)
SELECT (SELECT year FROM earliest_year) AS season_year, runner_up.time AS runner_up_time_gap
FROM runner_up
LIMIT 1;

WITH italian_gp AS (

)
SELECT drivers.code
FROM drivers
JOIN q3_drivers ON drivers.driverId = q3_drivers.driverId
ORDER BY drivers.code ASC;

WITH canadian_gp AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.year, r.date, r.time
  FROM races r
  WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
    AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017
), start_time_filter AS (

), winners AS (
  SELECT rr.raceId, rr.time as finish_time, d.forename, d.surname, stf.year
  FROM results rr
  JOIN drivers d ON rr.driverId = d.driverId
  JOIN start_time_filter stf ON rr.raceId = stf.raceId
  WHERE rr.positionOrder = 1
)
SELECT year, forename, surname, finish_time
FROM winners
ORDER BY year;

WITH Q3_2017_ItalianGP AS (  
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q3  
  FROM qualifying q  
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId  
  WHERE r.year = 2017  
    AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'  
    AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL  
    AND q.q3 < 98.000 -- faster than 1 minute 38 seconds
), 
DriverNumbers AS (
  SELECT d.driverId, d.code AS permanent_race_number, d.surname 
  FROM drivers d
)
SELECT DISTINCT dn.permanent_race_number, dn.surname
FROM Q3_2017_ItalianGP q3
JOIN DriverNumbers dn ON q3.driverId = dn.driverId;

WITH StartTimes AS (
  SELECT
    races.circuitId,
    circuits.circuitRef,
    races.time AS start_time
  FROM races
  JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
  WHERE races.time IS NOT NULL
),
TimeBounds AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(start_time) AS earliest_time,
    MAX(start_time) AS latest_time
  FROM StartTimes
),
EarliestCircuits AS (
  SELECT circuitRef, start_time FROM StartTimes, TimeBounds WHERE start_time = earliest_time
),
LatestCircuits AS (
  SELECT circuitRef, start_time FROM StartTimes, TimeBounds WHERE start_time = latest_time
),
Diff AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((JULIANDAY(latest_time) - JULIANDAY(earliest_time)) * 86400 AS INTEGER) AS gap_seconds
  FROM TimeBounds
)
SELECT
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuitRef) FROM EarliestCircuits) AS earliest_circuit_refs,
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuitRef) FROM LatestCircuits) AS latest_circuit_refs,
  (SELECT gap_seconds FROM Diff) AS gap_seconds
;

WITH DriverFastestSpeeds AS (
  SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob, MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS FLOAT)) AS max_speed
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
  WHERE d.dob BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1990-12-31'

)

ORDER BY max_speed DESC, dob ASC, surname ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH italian_gp AS (

),
first_qs AS (

SELECT d.driverRef, f.first_segment_time

ORDER BY f.first_segment_time DESC, f.driverId ASC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_withdrawn

WITH RaceDrivers AS (

  JOIN drivers d ON rs.driverId = d.driverId

ClassifiedFinishers AS (

)
SELECT ROUND(

WITH womens_soccer_attendance AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT attendance.link_to_member), 0) AS total_attendance
  FROM event
  LEFT JOIN attendance ON event.event_id = attendance.link_to_event
  WHERE event.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
    AND event.event_date BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-11-30'
), all_fall_events AS (
  SELECT event.event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT attendance.link_to_member) AS attendance_count
  FROM event
  LEFT JOIN attendance ON event.event_id = attendance.link_to_event
  WHERE event.event_date BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-11-30'
  GROUP BY event.event_id
), fall_average AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendance_count), 1) AS avg_attendance
  FROM all_fall_events
)
SELECT
  womens_soccer_attendance.total_attendance AS womens_soccer,
  fall_average.avg_attendance AS average_fall_attendance,
  CASE
    WHEN womens_soccer_attendance.total_attendance > fall_average.avg_attendance THEN 'more'
    WHEN womens_soccer_attendance.total_attendance < fall_average.avg_attendance THEN 'fewer'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS verdict
FROM womens_soccer_attendance, fall_average
LIMIT 1;

WITH humanities_departments AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.department
    FROM major m
    WHERE m.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),
majors_offered AS (
    SELECT m.department, m.major_name
    FROM major m
    WHERE m.department IN (SELECT department FROM humanities_departments)
),
majors_held AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.department, m.major_name
    FROM member mb
    JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id
    WHERE m.department IN (SELECT department FROM humanities_departments)
),
members_per_major AS (
    SELECT m.department, m.major_name, COUNT(mb.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM member mb
    JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id
    WHERE m.department IN (SELECT department FROM humanities_departments)
    GROUP BY m.department, m.major_name
),
members_per_major_avg AS (
  SELECT
    department,
    ROUND(AVG(member_count), 2) AS avg_members_per_major
  FROM members_per_major
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT 
    hd.department,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT mo.major_name) AS majors_offered,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT mh.major_name) AS majors_held_by_members,
    COALESCE(mpa.avg_members_per_major, 0) AS avg_members_per_major
FROM humanities_departments hd
LEFT JOIN majors_offered mo ON hd.department = mo.department
LEFT JOIN majors_held mh ON hd.department = mh.department
LEFT JOIN members_per_major_avg mpa ON hd.department = mpa.department
GROUP BY hd.department, mpa.avg_members_per_major
ORDER BY hd.department;

WITH MemberExpenses AS (
    SELECT 
        link_to_member,
        SUM(cost) AS total_expense
    FROM expense
    GROUP BY link_to_member
    HAVING SUM(cost) > 50
),
BudgetLeft AS (
    SELECT 
        b.budget_id,
        b.remaining
    FROM budget b
),
ExpensesBudget AS (
    SELECT 
        e.link_to_member,
        b.remaining
    FROM expense e
    LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE e.link_to_member IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM MemberExpenses)
)

SELECT 
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    ROUND(SUM(eb.remaining), 2) AS total_amount_left
FROM ExpensesBudget eb
JOIN member m ON eb.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY eb.link_to_member, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, m.last_name ASC, m.first_name ASC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH tyler_major_college AS (
  SELECT college
  FROM major
  WHERE major_id = (
    SELECT link_to_major
    FROM member
    WHERE first_name = 'Tyler' AND last_name = 'Hewitt'

  )
),
college_majors AS (

  WHERE college = (SELECT college FROM tyler_major_college)
),
majors_with_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_major
