)
SELECT cm.major_name, COUNT(*) AS no_member_count
FROM college_majors cm
LEFT JOIN majors_with_members mwm ON cm.major_id = mwm.link_to_major
WHERE mwm.link_to_major IS NULL
GROUP BY cm.major_name;

WITH AdvertisingEvents AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event
  FROM budget
  WHERE lower(category) LIKE '%advertising%'
),
AttendanceCount AS (
  SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) as members_attended

  WHERE link_to_event IN (SELECT link_to_event FROM AdvertisingEvents)

)
SELECT

WITH budget_events AS (
  SELECT event_id, event_name, location
  FROM event
  WHERE LOWER(event_name) LIKE '%budget review%'
), attendance_counts AS (
  SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS member_count

)
SELECT b.event_name, b.location, COALESCE(a.member_count, 0) AS members_attended
FROM budget_events b
LEFT JOIN attendance_counts a ON b.event_id = a.link_to_event;

WITH football_event AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE LOWER(event_name) LIKE '%football%'
    LIMIT 1
),
attendees AS (
    SELECT link_to_member
    FROM attendance
    WHERE link_to_event = (SELECT event_id FROM football_event)
),
major_counts AS (
    SELECT mj.major_name, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendees a
    JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
    GROUP BY mj.major_name
),
max_count AS (
    SELECT MAX(attendee_count) AS max_attendee
    FROM major_counts
)
SELECT mc.major_name, mc.attendee_count
FROM major_counts mc, max_count
WHERE mc.attendee_count = max_count.max_attendee
ORDER BY mc.major_name ASC;

WITH OverBudgetEvents AS (
  SELECT b.link_to_event AS event_id
  FROM budget b
  LEFT JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  GROUP BY b.budget_id
  HAVING SUM(COALESCE(e.cost, 0)) > SUM(b.amount)
), PurchasesInOverBudgetEvents AS (
  SELECT e.expense_description
  FROM expense e
  JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  JOIN OverBudgetEvents obe ON b.link_to_event = obe.event_id
), 
ExplodedDescriptions AS (
  SELECT 
    TRIM(SUBSTR(expense_description, 1, INSTR(expense_description || ',', ',') - 1)) AS kind,
    SUBSTR(expense_description || ',', INSTR(expense_description || ',', ',') + 1) AS rest
  FROM PurchasesInOverBudgetEvents
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    TRIM(SUBSTR(rest, 1, INSTR(rest, ',') - 1)) AS kind,
    SUBSTR(rest, INSTR(rest, ',') + 1) AS rest
  FROM ExplodedDescriptions
  WHERE rest <> ''
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(kind)) AS different_kinds_count
FROM ExplodedDescriptions
WHERE kind <> ''
LIMIT 1000;

WITH EventAttendance AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM event e
    JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
), WaterExpenses AS (
    SELECT a.link_to_event AS event_id, COALESCE(SUM(exp.cost), 0) AS water_spent
    FROM attendance a
    JOIN expense exp ON exp.link_to_member = a.link_to_member
    WHERE exp.expense_description LIKE '%bottle%' OR exp.expense_description LIKE '%water%'
    GROUP BY a.link_to_event
)
SELECT
    ea.event_name,
    ROUND(COALESCE(we.water_spent, 0) / ea.attendee_count, 2) AS spent_per_attendee
FROM EventAttendance ea
LEFT JOIN WaterExpenses we ON we.event_id = ea.event_id
ORDER BY ea.event_name, ea.event_id;

WITH member_major_college AS (

  FROM member m
  LEFT JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
)
SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 1 END) AS major_in_college_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN college != 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' OR college IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS not_major_in_college_count
FROM member_major_college;

WITH vp_members AS (
  SELECT member_id
  FROM member
  WHERE position = 'Vice President'
), vp_expenses AS (
  SELECT e.expense_date, e.cost
  FROM expense e
  JOIN vp_members vm ON e.link_to_member = vm.member_id
), latest_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(expense_date) AS max_date
  FROM vp_expenses
), expenses_on_latest_date AS (
  SELECT cost
  FROM vp_expenses
  WHERE expense_date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_date)
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT max_date FROM latest_date) AS expense_date, 
  SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM expenses_on_latest_date;

WITH EventTypes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.type
    FROM event e
    WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
), AttendeesPerType AS (
    SELECT e.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS num_members
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT et.type, COALESCE(apt.num_members, 0) AS num_members
FROM EventTypes et
LEFT JOIN AttendeesPerType apt ON et.type = apt.type
ORDER BY et.type;

WITH roster_majors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.link_to_major AS major_id
  FROM member m
  WHERE m.link_to_major IS NOT NULL
), college_counts AS (
  SELECT maj.college, COUNT(*) AS major_count
  FROM major maj
  JOIN roster_majors rm ON maj.major_id = rm.major_id
  GROUP BY maj.college
), max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(major_count) AS max_major_count
  FROM college_counts
)
SELECT college, major_count
FROM college_counts
WHERE major_count = (SELECT max_major_count FROM max_count)
ORDER BY college;

WITH PizzaEvents AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.link_to_event
  FROM expense e
  JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
  WHERE ev.event_date BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-09-30'
    AND e.expense_description LIKE '%pizza%'
)
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS total_budgeted_amount
FROM budget b
WHERE b.link_to_event IN (SELECT link_to_event FROM PizzaEvents);

WITH EventAttendanceCounts AS (
    SELECT event.type AS event_type, COUNT(DISTINCT attendance.link_to_member) AS member_count
    FROM event
    JOIN attendance ON event.event_id = attendance.link_to_event
    WHERE event.event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND event.event_date <= '2020-05-31'
    GROUP BY event.type
),
MaxAttendance AS (
    SELECT MAX(member_count) AS max_count
    FROM EventAttendanceCounts
)
SELECT event_type, member_count
FROM EventAttendanceCounts
WHERE member_count = (SELECT max_count FROM MaxAttendance);

SELECT expense_description AS item_name, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count
FROM expense
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Sacha' AND member.last_name = 'Harrison'
GROUP BY expense_description
ORDER BY purchase_count DESC;

WITH purchases AS (
  SELECT
    link_to_member AS member_id,
    expense_description AS item,
    SUM(cost) AS total_spending
  FROM expense
  WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', expense_date) IN ('2019-10', '2019-11')
  GROUP BY link_to_member, expense_description
),
kinds_per_member AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT item) AS different_kinds,
    SUM(total_spending) AS total_spending
  FROM purchases
  GROUP BY member_id
),
max_kinds AS (
  SELECT MAX(different_kinds) AS max_kinds FROM kinds_per_member
)
SELECT
  m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS fullname,
  k.different_kinds,
  k.total_spending
FROM kinds_per_member k
JOIN max_kinds mk ON k.different_kinds = mk.max_kinds
JOIN member m ON k.member_id = m.member_id
;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT major.major_name) AS distinct_majors_count
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.department = 'Political Science';

WITH marvel_characters AS (
  SELECT id, height_cm
  FROM superhero
  WHERE publisher_id = 13 AND height_cm IS NOT NULL AND height_cm > 0
),
marvel_powers AS (
  SELECT hero_id, power_id
  FROM hero_power
  WHERE hero_id IN (SELECT id FROM marvel_characters)
),
dc_powers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT power_id
  FROM hero_power
  WHERE hero_id IN (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 4)
),
unique_marvel_powers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT power_id
  FROM marvel_powers
  WHERE power_id NOT IN (SELECT power_id FROM dc_powers)
),
marvel_chars_with_unique_power AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hero_id
  FROM marvel_powers
  WHERE power_id IN (SELECT power_id FROM unique_marvel_powers)
)
SELECT AVG(height_cm) AS avg_height_cm
FROM marvel_characters
WHERE id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM marvel_chars_with_unique_power)
LIMIT 1000;

WITH strength_heroes AS (
  SELECT superhero.id
  FROM superhero
  JOIN hero_power ON hero_power.hero_id = superhero.id
  JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
  WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Super Strength'
),
powers_of_strength_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hero_power.power_id
  FROM hero_power
  JOIN strength_heroes ON hero_power.hero_id = strength_heroes.id
),
powers_of_non_strength_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hero_power.power_id
  FROM hero_power
  JOIN superhero ON hero_power.hero_id = superhero.id
  WHERE superhero.id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM strength_heroes)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_of_powers_held_only_by_strength_heroes
FROM powers_of_strength_heroes
WHERE power_id NOT IN (SELECT power_id FROM powers_of_non_strength_heroes);

WITH green_heroes AS (
  SELECT s.weight_kg
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
  WHERE c.colour = 'green' AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND s.weight_kg > 0
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 1) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM green_heroes;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS neutral_hero_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment NOT IN ('good', 'bad')

WITH RankedHeroes AS (
    SELECT id, height_cm,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
    FROM superhero
), TopTenOrTied AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM RankedHeroes
    WHERE height_rank <= (
        SELECT MAX(height_rank) 
        FROM RankedHeroes 
        WHERE height_rank <= 10
    )
), PowersOfTopHeroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hero_power.hero_id, hero_power.power_id
    FROM hero_power
    JOIN TopTenOrTied ON hero_power.hero_id = TopTenOrTied.id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS distinct_superpower_count
FROM PowersOfTopHeroes;

WITH a_bomb_publisher AS (
  SELECT p.id AS publisher_id
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  WHERE s.superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_no_race
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN a_bomb_publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.publisher_id
WHERE s.race_id IS NULL;

WITH CryokinesisHolders AS (
  SELECT hero_id
  FROM hero_power
  WHERE power_id = 19
),
SharedHeroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hero_id
  FROM hero_power
  WHERE power_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT power_id
    FROM hero_power
    WHERE hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM CryokinesisHolders)
  )
),
HeroPowerCounts AS (
  SELECT hero_id, COUNT(power_id) AS power_count
  FROM hero_power
  WHERE hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM SharedHeroes)
  GROUP BY hero_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1) AS avg_power_count
FROM HeroPowerCounts;

WITH abomb_hero AS (
  SELECT id, height_cm
  FROM superhero
  WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
), abomb_alignment AS (
  SELECT alignment_id
  FROM abomb_hero
  JOIN superhero ON abomb_hero.id = superhero.id
), group_heroes AS (
  SELECT height_cm
  FROM superhero
  WHERE alignment_id IN (SELECT alignment_id FROM abomb_alignment)
    AND height_cm IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 1) AS average_height_cm
FROM group_heroes;

WITH FemaleHeroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.race_id
    FROM superhero h
    JOIN gender g ON h.gender_id = g.id
    WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
),
NonFemaleRaces AS (
    SELECT r.id
    FROM race r
    WHERE r.id NOT IN (SELECT race_id FROM FemaleHeroes)
),
EligibleHeroes AS (
    SELECT weight_kg
    FROM superhero
    WHERE race_id IN (SELECT id FROM NonFemaleRaces) AND weight_kg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(weight_kg) AS avg_weight_kg FROM EligibleHeroes;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS num_publishers
FROM publisher p
JOIN superhero s ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE s.height_cm > 200;

WITH NonDCGoodHeroes AS (
    SELECT sh.id
    FROM superhero sh
    JOIN alignment a ON sh.alignment_id = a.id
    JOIN publisher p ON sh.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE a.alignment = 'Good' AND p.publisher_name != 'DC Comics'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_non_dc_good_heroes FROM NonDCGoodHeroes;

WITH blackwulf_publisher AS (
    SELECT p.id
    FROM publisher p
    JOIN superhero s ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'
    LIMIT 1
), 
blackwulf_heroes_eye_colour AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero h, blackwulf_publisher bp
    WHERE h.publisher_id = bp.id
      AND h.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
), 
other_publishers_eye_colour AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero h
    WHERE h.publisher_id IS NOT NULL
      AND h.publisher_id != (SELECT id FROM blackwulf_publisher)
      AND h.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
),
common_eye_colours AS (
    SELECT eye_colour_id
    FROM blackwulf_heroes_eye_colour
    INTERSECT
    SELECT eye_colour_id
    FROM other_publishers_eye_colour
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM superhero h
WHERE h.publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM blackwulf_publisher)
  AND h.eye_colour_id IN (SELECT eye_colour_id FROM common_eye_colours)
;

WITH PublisherForCharles AS (
    SELECT s.publisher_id
    FROM superhero s
    WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
    LIMIT 1
), PublisherSuperheroes AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.race_id
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN PublisherForCharles pfc ON s.publisher_id = pfc.publisher_id
    WHERE s.race_id IS NOT NULL
), RaceCounts AS (
    SELECT race_id, COUNT(*) AS race_count
    FROM PublisherSuperheroes
    GROUP BY race_id
), MaxRaceCount AS (
    SELECT MAX(race_count) AS max_count
    FROM RaceCounts
)
SELECT r.race AS race_name, rc.race_count
FROM RaceCounts rc
JOIN MaxRaceCount mrc ON rc.race_count = mrc.max_count
JOIN race r ON rc.race_id = r.id;

WITH female_heroes AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.weight_kg
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
  WHERE g.gender = 'Female' AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM female_heroes;

WITH hero_powers_count AS (
  SELECT
    superhero.id AS hero_id,
    superhero.gender_id,
    COUNT(hero_power.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM superhero
  LEFT JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
  WHERE superhero.full_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY superhero.id
), gender_avg AS (
  SELECT
    gender.id AS gender_id,
    gender.gender AS gender,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(power_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_powers
  FROM gender
  LEFT JOIN hero_powers_count ON gender.id = hero_powers_count.gender_id
  WHERE gender.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
  GROUP BY gender.id
)
SELECT gender, avg_powers FROM gender_avg;

WITH green_villains AS (
  SELECT s.height_cm, s.weight_kg
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
  JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
  WHERE a.alignment = 'Villain'
  AND c.colour = 'green'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 2) AS avg_height_cm,
  ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM green_villains
WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL AND weight_kg IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 1;

WITH george_lucas_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.weight_kg
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
), heroes_with_powers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(glh.weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM george_lucas_heroes glh
JOIN heroes_with_powers hwp ON glh.id = hwp.hero_id
WHERE glh.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH female_good_heroes AS (
  SELECT sh.weight_kg
  FROM superhero sh
  JOIN gender g ON sh.gender_id = g.id
  JOIN alignment al ON sh.alignment_id = al.id
  WHERE g.gender = 'Female' AND al.alignment = 'Good' AND sh.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM female_good_heroes;

WITH LightestWeight AS (
  SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS min_weight
  FROM superhero
  WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
), HeroesWithLightestWeight AS (
  SELECT s.id
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN LightestWeight lw ON s.weight_kg = lw.min_weight
), HeroPowerCounts AS (
  SELECT h.id AS hero_id, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM HeroesWithLightestWeight h
  LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON h.id = hp.hero_id
  GROUP BY h.id
)
SELECT MAX(power_count) AS max_power_count
FROM HeroPowerCounts;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS neutral_heroes_with_full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral'
AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
AND s.full_name != ''

WITH HairColourAttr AS (
  SELECT id FROM attribute WHERE attribute_name = 'hair_colour'
), EyeColourAttr AS (
  SELECT id FROM attribute WHERE attribute_name = 'eye_colour'
),
BrownHairHeroes AS (
  SELECT ha.hero_id
  FROM hero_attribute ha
  JOIN HairColourAttr hca ON ha.attribute_id = hca.id
  JOIN colour c ON ha.attribute_value = c.id
  WHERE c.colour = 'brown'
),
BrownHairEyeColours AS (
  SELECT ha.attribute_value AS eye_colour_id
  FROM hero_attribute ha
  JOIN EyeColourAttr eca ON ha.attribute_id = eca.id
  WHERE ha.hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM BrownHairHeroes)
  GROUP BY ha.attribute_value
),
NonBrownHairCounts AS (
  SELECT ha.attribute_value AS eye_colour_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) AS count
  FROM hero_attribute ha
  JOIN EyeColourAttr eca ON ha.attribute_id = eca.id
  WHERE ha.attribute_value IN (SELECT eye_colour_id FROM BrownHairEyeColours)
    AND ha.hero_id NOT IN (SELECT hero_id FROM BrownHairHeroes)
  GROUP BY ha.attribute_value
)
SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour, COALESCE(nbc.count, 0) AS count
FROM colour c
JOIN NonBrownHairCounts nbc ON c.id = nbc.eye_colour_id
ORDER BY count DESC, eye_colour ASC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH MarvelHeroes AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.full_name, a.alignment
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
),
Stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_with_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN alignment = 'good' THEN 1 END) AS good_count
  FROM MarvelHeroes
)
SELECT ROUND(CAST(good_count AS FLOAT) / total_with_name * 100, 2) AS percentage_good
FROM Stats;

WITH MarvelGoodHeroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.id
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
  JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND a.alignment = 'good'
), MarvelHeroesWithPower AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.id
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
)
SELECT ROUND(CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MarvelGoodHeroes) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MarvelHeroesWithPower), 2) AS percentage_good;

WITH no_weight_heroes AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE weight_kg IS NULL
),
hero_eye_colours AS (
    SELECT h.id, c.colour
    FROM no_weight_heroes h
    JOIN superhero s ON h.id = s.id
    JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_eye_colours WHERE colour = 'No Colour') -
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_eye_colours WHERE colour = 'Blue') AS difference
;

WITH Abnormal_PT_Patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
    WHERE DATE('2026-10-09') > DATE(p.Birthday, '+55 years')
      AND l.PT IS NOT NULL
      AND (l.PT < 70 OR l.PT > 130)  -- Assuming abnormal PT values are out of this range
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS female_percentage
FROM Abnormal_PT_Patients;

WITH PositiveCRP AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID AS PatientID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CRP = 'positive'
),
NoDescriptionPatients AS (
    SELECT ID AS PatientID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Description IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_distinct_patients
FROM PositiveCRP p
JOIN NoDescriptionPatients n ON p.PatientID = n.PatientID;

WITH NormalScl70 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.SEX = 'female'
    AND l.SC170 = 'normal'
),
SymptomExams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
  FROM Examination e
  WHERE e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
    AND e.Symptoms != ''
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_female_patients
FROM NormalScl70 ns
WHERE ns.ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM SymptomExams);

WITH patients_in_range AS (
  SELECT ID, Birthday, Admission
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
), patients_with_lab AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
  FROM patients_in_range p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
), target_patients AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.Admission
  FROM patients_with_lab pwl
  JOIN patients_in_range p ON pwl.ID = p.ID
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = 'inpatient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM target_patients;

WITH RankedTests AS (
  SELECT
    Laboratory."T-BIL" AS total_bilirubin,
    CAST(Laboratory.RNP AS REAL) AS anti_ribonuclear_protein,
    Laboratory.Date AS lab_date,
    Laboratory.ID AS lab_id,
    Patient.ID AS patient_id,
    Patient.SEX AS sex,
    Patient.Birthday AS birthday,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(Laboratory.RNP AS REAL) DESC) AS rnk_arp
  FROM Laboratory
  JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
  WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL AND RNP != ''
),
MaxTotalBilirubinAmongStrongestARP AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_bilirubin) AS max_total_bilirubin
  FROM RankedTests
  WHERE rnk_arp = 1
)
SELECT
  lab_date,
  patient_id,
  sex,
  birthday,
  total_bilirubin
FROM RankedTests, MaxTotalBilirubinAmongStrongestARP
WHERE rnk_arp = 1
  AND total_bilirubin = max_total_bilirubin
ORDER BY lab_date, patient_id
;

WITH ThrombosisPatientIDs AS (
  SELECT p.ID
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1 AND p.Birthday > '1960-01-01'
), RaisedRNPPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN ThrombosisPatientIDs t ON l.ID = t.ID
  WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL AND l.RNP != 'negative' AND CAST(l.RNP AS FLOAT) > 10
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patients_never_raised_rnp
FROM ThrombosisPatientIDs
WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM RaisedRNPPatients)
LIMIT 1

WITH MCTD_Patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
  AND ID NOT IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis != 'MCTD'
  )
),
PlateletNormal AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE PLT BETWEEN 150 AND 450
),
AntiRNPHigh AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CAST(RNP AS FLOAT) > 5
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS PatientCount
FROM MCTD_Patients
WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM PlateletNormal)
AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM AntiRNPHigh)

WITH NeverExaminedPatients AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient p
    LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    WHERE e.ID IS NULL
),
LabCounts AS (
    SELECT n.SEX, n.ID, COUNT(DISTINCT l.Date) AS lab_test_dates_count
    FROM NeverExaminedPatients n
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON n.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY n.ID
)
SELECT 
    SEX AS sex,
    ROUND(AVG(lab_test_dates_count), 2) AS avg_lab_test_dates
FROM LabCounts
WHERE SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY SEX;

WITH FemaleInpatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID as patient_id
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX = 'female' AND Admission = 'inpatient'
),
MaxAntiDNA AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(DNA AS FLOAT)) AS max_level
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE DNA IS NOT NULL AND ID IN (SELECT patient_id FROM FemaleInpatients)
)
SELECT ID AS patient_id, Date AS test_date, CAST(DNA AS FLOAT) AS anti_dna_antibody_level
FROM Laboratory
WHERE DNA IS NOT NULL AND CAST(DNA AS FLOAT) = (SELECT max_level FROM MaxAntiDNA)
  AND ID IN (SELECT patient_id FROM FemaleInpatients)
ORDER BY ID;

WITH 
  NonNormalHCT AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HCT < 35 OR HCT > 50
  ),
  HighRNP AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 16
  ),
  QualifiedPatients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM NonNormalHCT
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ID
    FROM HighRNP
  )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS PatientCount
FROM QualifiedPatients;
SELECT MAX(ANA) AS highest_anti_ribonuclear_protein_value FROM Examination;

WITH Female_SLE_Exams AS (
  SELECT e.ID, e."Examination Date" AS exam_date
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.SEX = 'female'
    AND e.Diagnosis LIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%'
),
TP_Above_Normal AS (
  SELECT l.TP
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Female_SLE_Exams fse ON l.ID = fse.ID AND l.Date = fse.exam_date
  WHERE l.TP > 8.5
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(TP - 8.5), 3) AS avg_deviation
FROM TP_Above_Normal;

WITH diagnosed_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.Birthday
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Patient.Diagnosis LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Birthday IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) >= '1960' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage_born_1960_or_later
FROM diagnosed_patients;

WITH LowAlbuminPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Sex
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.ALB < 3.5
)
SELECT Sex AS sex, COUNT(ID) AS patient_count
FROM LowAlbuminPatients
GROUP BY Sex;

WITH RelevantPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pt.ID, pt.Birthday
  FROM Patient pt
  JOIN Laboratory lb ON pt.ID = lb.ID
  WHERE (
    (strftime('%Y', lb.Date) < '1987' AND lb."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4'))
    OR (strftime('%Y', lb.Date) >= '1987' AND (
      lb."U-PRO" IN ('300', '1000') OR CAST(lb."U-PRO" AS INTEGER) > 1000
    ))
  )
)
SELECT AVG((1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER))) AS avg_age_1999
FROM RelevantPatients
;

WITH HighMeasurementPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID AS patient_id, p.SEX
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL AND CAST(l.RNP AS FLOAT) > 32
)

SELECT
  SEX,
  COUNT(patient_id) AS patient_count
FROM HighMeasurementPatients
GROUP BY SEX;

WITH PsoriaticArthritisPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Patient.Diagnosis LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory WHERE ID IN (SELECT patient_id FROM PsoriaticArthritisPatients)) AS total_lab_tests,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PsoriaticArthritisPatients
   WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory)) AS patients_with_no_lab_tests
;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS thrombosis_patient_count
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 1
  AND Examination."Examination Date" >= '1997-01-01'
  AND Examination."Examination Date" <= '1997-12-31';

WITH SLEPatients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
),
ThromboticEpisodes AS (
  SELECT Symptoms
  FROM Examination
  WHERE Thrombosis = 1 AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM SLEPatients)
)
SELECT Symptoms AS symptom
FROM ThromboticEpisodes
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, Symptoms ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH ThrombosisPatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis = 1
),
SLEAtExam AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
      AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM ThrombosisPatients)
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SLEAtExam) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ThrombosisPatients), 0),
    2
) AS Percentage_SLE_Diagnosed_Among_Thrombosis_Patients
FROM Examination
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    p.SEX AS sex,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM
    Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE
    l.Date BETWEEN '1994-01-01' AND '1994-12-31'
    AND l.GOT BETWEEN 0 AND 40
GROUP BY
    p.SEX
ORDER BY
    p.SEX;

WITH PatientLabs AS (
  SELECT
    Patient.ID AS patient_id,
    Patient.Birthday AS dob,
    Laboratory.Date AS lab_date,
    Laboratory.LDH AS LDH_result,
    CASE 
      WHEN Laboratory."U-PRO" LIKE 'at least %' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(Laboratory."U-PRO", 10) AS INTEGER)
      ELSE CAST(Laboratory."U-PRO" AS INTEGER)
    END AS urine_protein_result
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
),
QualifiedPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT patient_id, dob
  FROM PatientLabs
  WHERE LDH_result > 600 AND LDH_result < 800
    AND urine_protein_result >= 300
)

SELECT
  patient_id,
  CAST((julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(dob))/365.25 AS INTEGER) AS completed_age
FROM QualifiedPatients;

WITH RA_Patients AS (
  SELECT ID, SEX
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%RA%'
),
Normal_UN_Range AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE UN BETWEEN 7 AND 20
)
SELECT (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM RA_Patients rp
  JOIN Normal_UN_Range nur ON rp.ID = nur.ID
  WHERE rp.SEX = 'F'
) - (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM RA_Patients rp
  JOIN Normal_UN_Range nur ON rp.ID = nur.ID
  WHERE rp.SEX = 'M'
) AS Female_minus_Male_Difference;

WITH PatientSex AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID, SEX
  FROM Patient
),
CreatinineAbnormal AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5
),
CountStats AS (
  SELECT
    ps.SEX,
    COUNT(ps.ID) AS total_patients,
    COUNT(ca.ID) AS patients_abnormal_creatinine
  FROM PatientSex ps
  LEFT JOIN CreatinineAbnormal ca ON ps.ID = ca.ID
  GROUP BY ps.SEX
)
SELECT
  SEX as sex,
  patients_abnormal_creatinine AS patients_out_of_range,
  total_patients,
  ROUND(100.0 * patients_abnormal_creatinine / total_patients, 1) AS share_percentage
FROM CountStats
ORDER BY sex DESC;

WITH MaxTCHOByAdmission AS (
    SELECT
        Patient.Admission AS admission_status,
        MAX(Laboratory."T-CHO") AS max_tcho
    FROM Laboratory
    JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
    JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
    WHERE Patient.Admission IN ('+', '-')
    GROUP BY Patient.Admission
),
MaxTCHOReadings AS (
    SELECT
        Patient.Admission AS admission_status,
        Laboratory."T-CHO" AS t_cho,
        Patient.ID AS patient_id
    FROM Laboratory
    JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
    JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
    JOIN MaxTCHOByAdmission ON MaxTCHOByAdmission.admission_status = Patient.Admission
        AND MaxTCHOByAdmission.max_tcho = Laboratory."T-CHO"
    WHERE Patient.Admission IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT admission_status, t_cho, patient_id
FROM MaxTCHOReadings
ORDER BY CASE WHEN admission_status = '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, patient_id;

WITH FirstVisitPatients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE strftime('%Y', "First Date") = '1991'
), MaxRNPLevel AS (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL)) AS max_level
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL AND RNP != ''
      AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM FirstVisitPatients)
)
SELECT ID AS patient_id, CAST(RNP AS REAL) AS anti_RNP_level
FROM Laboratory
WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) = (SELECT max_level FROM MaxRNPLevel)
  AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM FirstVisitPatients)

WITH MostRecentLabDate AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS PatientID,
    MAX(l.Date) AS MaxSampleDate
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID
),
MostRecentSC170 AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID AS PatientID,
    l.SC170,
    l.Date
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ID,
      SC170,
      Date,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE SC170 IS NOT NULL
  ) l
  WHERE l.rn = 1
)
SELECT m.PatientID
FROM MostRecentLabDate m
JOIN MostRecentSC170 s ON m.PatientID = s.PatientID
WHERE m.MaxSampleDate > '1997-01-01'
  AND s.SC170 = 'normal'
;

WITH FemalePatientsWithLowAntiDNALevel AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.SEX = 'female'
    AND (
      (l.DNA IS NOT NULL AND CAST(l.DNA AS FLOAT) < 8) OR
      (l."DNA-II" IS NOT NULL AND l."DNA-II" < 8)
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_patient_count
FROM FemalePatientsWithLowAntiDNALevel;

WITH AdmittedPatients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission IS NOT NULL
),
HighALPPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN AdmittedPatients ap ON l.ID = ap.ID
  WHERE l.ALP > 120  -- Assumed 120 as normal ceiling for alkaliphosphatase level based on typical clinical values
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_never_high_alkaliphosphatase
FROM AdmittedPatients ap
WHERE ap.ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM HighALPPatients)

WITH SevereAnemiaPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.HGB < 8
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 'female'
       WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 'male'
       ELSE 'other'
  END AS sex,
  COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM SevereAnemiaPatients
GROUP BY sex
ORDER BY sex;

WITH PatientEligible AS (
  SELECT
    ID
  FROM
    Patient
  WHERE
    Birthday > '1980-01-01'
),
AbnormalFibrinogen AS (
  SELECT
    ID
  FROM
    Laboratory
  WHERE
    FG IS NOT NULL AND (FG < 150 OR FG > 450)
),
SevereProteinuria AS (
  SELECT
    ID
  FROM
    Laboratory
  WHERE
    "U-PRO" IN ('3+', '4+')
),
EligiblePatients AS (
  SELECT ID FROM PatientEligible
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM AbnormalFibrinogen)
  OR ID IN (SELECT ID FROM SevereProteinuria)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS eligible_patient_count FROM EligiblePatients;

WITH FemalePatients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX = 'F'
    AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1945' AND '1989'
    AND Admission = 'admitted'
),
P_Only_Exams AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Examination
  WHERE "ANA Pattern" = 'P'
  GROUP BY ID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "ANA Pattern") = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fp.ID) AS admitted_female_p_count
FROM FemalePatients fp
JOIN Examination e ON fp.ID = e.ID
WHERE e."ANA Pattern" = 'P'
  AND e.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM P_Only_Exams);

WITH OutpatientAnemiaPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.Admission != 'inpatient'
    AND l.HGB < 10
),
MaxAntiRNPLevels AS (
  SELECT l.ID, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS max_anti_rnp
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL AND l.RNP <> ''
  GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, p.SEX AS sex, m.max_anti_rnp
FROM OutpatientAnemiaPatients p
JOIN MaxAntiRNPLevels m ON p.ID = m.ID
WHERE m.max_anti_rnp = (SELECT MAX(max_anti_rnp) FROM MaxAntiRNPLevels)
LIMIT 1000;

WITH FirstLab AS (
  SELECT
    ID AS PatientID,
    MIN(Date) AS FirstTestDate
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
RelevantLabs AS (
  SELECT
    L.ID AS PatientID,
    L.Date,
    L.GOT,
    L.RNP
  FROM Laboratory L
  JOIN FirstLab FL ON L.ID = FL.PatientID AND L.Date = FL.FirstTestDate
),
PatientLabSummary AS (
  SELECT
    PatientID,
    GOT,
    RNP
  FROM RelevantLabs
  WHERE GOT < 60 AND CAST(RNP AS INTEGER) > 10
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PatientID) AS NumPatients
FROM PatientLabSummary;

WITH LatestProteinuria AS (
  SELECT
    ID AS PatientID,
    MAX(Date) AS MostRecentTestDate
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
)

SELECT
  p.ID AS PatientID,
  p.SEX AS Sex,
  lp.MostRecentTestDate AS TestDate,
  l."U-PRO" AS ProteinuriaLevel
FROM LatestProteinuria lp
JOIN Laboratory l ON lp.PatientID = l.ID AND lp.MostRecentTestDate = l.Date
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = lp.PatientID
ORDER BY p.ID;

WITH ElevatedAntiRNPPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RNP >= '16'
),
NormalGPTLabs AS (
  SELECT ID, MAX(GPT) AS MaxNormalGPT
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE GPT < 60
  GROUP BY ID
),
QualifiedPatients AS (
  SELECT p.ID, n.MaxNormalGPT
  FROM ElevatedAntiRNPPatients p
  JOIN NormalGPTLabs n ON p.ID = n.ID
)
SELECT pa.Birthday
FROM QualifiedPatients q
JOIN Patient pa ON q.ID = pa.ID
ORDER BY q.MaxNormalGPT DESC, q.ID ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH FilteredLab AS (
  SELECT ID, PT, RNP
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE PT < 14
    AND CAST(RNP AS INTEGER) >= 16
), FemalePatients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX = 'Female'
), ThrombosisCohort AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Examination
  WHERE Thrombosis = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fp.ID) AS FemalePatientCount
FROM FemalePatients fp
JOIN FilteredLab fl ON fp.ID = fl.ID
JOIN ThrombosisCohort tc ON fp.ID = tc.ID;

WITH max_anti_dna AS (
  SELECT Date, DNA, ID AS lab_id
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE DNA IS NOT NULL AND DNA != ''
  ORDER BY CAST(DNA AS REAL) DESC, Date
  LIMIT 1
), 
patient_lab AS (
  SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, p.Birthday, p.Diagnosis AS patient_diagnosis, l.Date AS lab_date, CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) AS dna_level
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.Admission = '+'
), 
selected AS (
  SELECT patient_id, Birthday, patient_diagnosis, lab_date, dna_level
  FROM patient_lab
  JOIN max_anti_dna ON max_anti_dna.Date = patient_lab.lab_date AND max_anti_dna.lab_id = patient_lab.patient_id
  ORDER BY lab_date
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  patient_id,
  (strftime('%Y', lab_date) - strftime('%Y', Birthday)) - (strftime('%m-%d', lab_date) < strftime('%m-%d', Birthday)) AS age_at_test,
  patient_diagnosis,
  dna_level,
  lab_date AS test_date
FROM selected
LIMIT 1;

WITH LupusPatients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%'
),
LiverAbnormalities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE [T-BIL] >= 1.2
)
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN LupusPatients lp ON p.ID = lp.ID
JOIN LiverAbnormalities la ON p.ID = la.ID
ORDER BY p.SEX, p.ID;

WITH FemalePatients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX = 'F' AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50
),
AntiRNPResults AS (
  SELECT ID,
         MAX(CASE WHEN RNP IS NOT NULL AND CAST(RNP AS INTEGER) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HasElevatedAntiRNP
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
AdmissionStatus AS (
  SELECT ID, Admission AS admission_marker
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission IN ('+', '-')
),
Combined AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fp.ID,
    CASE WHEN asn.admission_marker = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
         WHEN asn.admission_marker = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
         ELSE NULL END AS care_setting,
    COALESCE(ar.HasElevatedAntiRNP, 0) AS HasElevatedAntiRNP
  FROM FemalePatients fp
  JOIN AdmissionStatus asn ON fp.ID = asn.ID
  LEFT JOIN AntiRNPResults ar ON fp.ID = ar.ID
  WHERE asn.admission_marker IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT care_setting,
       SUM(CASE WHEN HasElevatedAntiRNP = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_elevated_antiRNP,
       SUM(CASE WHEN HasElevatedAntiRNP = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_without_elevated_antiRNP
FROM Combined
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting ASC;

WITH PatientSetting AS (
  SELECT
    ID AS patient_id,
    CASE WHEN Admission IS NOT NULL THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS care_setting
  FROM Patient
),
LatestIgG AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID AS laboratory_id,
    p.patient_id,
    l.IGG,
    l.Date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.patient_id ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN PatientSetting p ON p.patient_id = l.ID
),
MostRecentIgG AS (
  SELECT patient_id, IGG
  FROM LatestIgG
  WHERE rn = 1
),
Stats AS (
  SELECT
    ps.care_setting,
    COUNT(*) AS total_patients,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN m.IGG > 0 THEN 1 END) AS normal_igg_patients
  FROM PatientSetting ps
  LEFT JOIN MostRecentIgG m ON ps.patient_id = m.patient_id
  GROUP BY ps.care_setting
)
SELECT
  care_setting,
  ROUND(CAST(normal_igg_patients AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / total_patients, 1) AS percentage_normal_igg
FROM Stats
ORDER BY care_setting DESC;

WITH LatestVisits AS (
    SELECT
        Patient.ID AS patient_id,
        Patient.SEX AS sex,
        MAX(Examination."Examination Date") AS max_visit_date
    FROM Patient
    JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
    GROUP BY Patient.ID
),
LatestAntiRNP AS (
    SELECT
        LatestVisits.patient_id,
        LatestVisits.sex,
        Laboratory.RNP AS anti_RNP_level
    FROM LatestVisits
    JOIN Examination ON LatestVisits.patient_id = Examination.ID AND LatestVisits.max_visit_date = Examination."Examination Date"
    JOIN Laboratory ON Laboratory.Date = Examination."Examination Date"
    WHERE Laboratory.RNP IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'female' AND CAST(anti_RNP_level AS INTEGER) >= 32 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) -
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'male' AND CAST(anti_RNP_level AS INTEGER) >= 32 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS female_minus_male_strongly_positive_anti_RNP
FROM LatestAntiRNP
LIMIT 1000;

WITH FemaleLabRecords AS (
    SELECT p.ID AS Patient_ID, l.Date, CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) AS Anti_RNP, l.CPK
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'Female'
    AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
),
MostRecentAS AS (
    SELECT Patient_ID, MAX(Date) AS MaxDate
    FROM FemaleLabRecords
    GROUP BY Patient_ID
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM FemaleLabRecords fl
JOIN MostRecentAS mr ON fl.Patient_ID = mr.Patient_ID AND fl.Date = mr.MaxDate
WHERE fl.Anti_RNP > 64 AND fl.CPK < 250;

WITH ConfirmedSLEPatients AS (
  SELECT ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE confirmed'
),
PatientInpatientStatus AS (
  SELECT p.patient_id,
    CASE WHEN Admission = 'inpatient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS inpatient,
    CASE WHEN Admission = 'outpatient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS outpatient
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT patient_id FROM ConfirmedSLEPatients)
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_confirmed_sle,
  SUM(inpatient) AS inpatient_count,
  SUM(outpatient) AS outpatient_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(inpatient) / NULLIF(SUM(inpatient) + SUM(outpatient), 0), 2) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM PatientInpatientStatus;

WITH ldh_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE LDH >= 500
),
proteinuria_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST("U-PRO" AS INTEGER) >= 100
)
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN ldh_patients l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN proteinuria_patients u ON p.ID = u.ID
ORDER BY p.ID;

WITH PatientsWithoutExamination AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient p
    LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    WHERE e.ID IS NULL
)
SELECT SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM PatientsWithoutExamination
GROUP BY SEX;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS female_admitted_1998
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'female'
  AND "First Date" BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND Admission = 'admitted';

WITH
first_half AS (
    SELECT p.ID, MIN(e."Examination Date") AS first_visit_date
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    WHERE e."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1998-02-15' AND '1998-02-28'
    GROUP BY p.ID
),
patients_first_seen AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.Birthday, e.Diagnosis, e."Examination Date"
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    JOIN first_half f ON p.ID = f.ID AND e."Examination Date" = f.first_visit_date
),
oldest AS (
    SELECT ID, Birthday, Diagnosis
    FROM patients_first_seen
    ORDER BY Birthday ASC, ID ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT Diagnosis FROM oldest;

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM"), 1) AS avg_anti_cardiolipin_IgM
FROM Examination
WHERE "Examination Date" BETWEEN '1993-10-01' AND '1993-10-31'
AND Diagnosis = 'systemic lupus erythematosus'
AND "aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL;

WITH ThrombosisPredictionCohort AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Description = 'thrombosis prediction'
),
DiagnosedPsoriaticArthritis AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'psoriatic arthritis'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.ID) AS patient_count
FROM ThrombosisPredictionCohort t
JOIN DiagnosedPsoriaticArthritis d ON t.ID = d.ID;

WITH PatientsWithAbnormalALT AS (
    SELECT p.ID
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.GPT > 40 -- assuming normal upper limit for ALT (GPT) is 40
    GROUP BY p.ID
),
AllPatients AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX IN ('Male', 'Female')
)
SELECT 
    SEX,
    COUNT(*) AS CountPatientsWithoutAbnormalALT
FROM AllPatients
WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM PatientsWithAbnormalALT)
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

WITH RBC_low_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID AS patient_id
  FROM Laboratory
  JOIN Patient ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
  WHERE Laboratory.RBC < 3.5
),
Patient_ages AS (
  SELECT 
    ID AS patient_id,
    (strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') - strftime('%Y', Birthday)) - 
    (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', Birthday)) AS age_2026,
    CASE WHEN Admission IS NOT NULL AND Admission <> '' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END AS care_setting_flag
  FROM Patient
)
SELECT 
  care_setting_flag,
  COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count,
  ROUND(AVG(age_2026), 1) AS avg_age
FROM Patient_ages
WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM RBC_low_patients)
GROUP BY care_setting_flag
ORDER BY care_setting_flag DESC;

WITH SJS_Patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis = 'SJS'
),
Measurements AS (
  SELECT e.[aCL IgM] AS anti_cardiolipin_IgM
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN SJS_Patients p ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE e.[aCL IgM] > 0
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(anti_cardiolipin_IgM), 2) AS avg_anti_cardiolipin_IgM
FROM Measurements;

WITH SjS_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
  FROM Examination
  JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
  WHERE Examination.Diagnosis = "Sjögren's syndrome"
    AND Patient.SEX = 'female'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_SjS_patient_count
FROM SjS_patients;

WITH OutpatientPatients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission = 'outpatient'
),
PatientsNormalRNP AS (
  SELECT p.ID
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
  WHERE (l.RNP = 'negative' OR l.RNP = '0')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pnr.ID) AS count
FROM PatientsNormalRNP pnr
JOIN OutpatientPatients op ON pnr.ID = op.ID;

WITH NormalAntiSMPatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE SM IN ('negative', '0')
),
NoThrombosisPatients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN Thrombosis != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
),
SignificantProteinuriaPatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', 'TR')
    AND CAST("U-PRO" AS FLOAT) >= 30
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n.ID) AS count_patients
FROM NormalAntiSMPatients n
JOIN NoThrombosisPatients nt ON n.ID = nt.ID
JOIN SignificantProteinuriaPatients s ON n.ID = s.ID;

WITH AntiRNP_Positive AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Birthday
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 64
),
AgeFiltered AS (
  SELECT ID, (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) -
           CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', Birthday) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
  FROM AntiRNP_Positive
  WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) -
        CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', Birthday) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END < 70
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(age), 1) AS average_age
FROM AgeFiltered;

WITH FilteredLabs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Laboratory.ID AS lab_id, Patient.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Laboratory
  JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
  WHERE WBC BETWEEN 3500 AND 10500
    AND (FG < 1.5 OR FG > 3.5)
    AND CAST(RNP AS FLOAT) > 15
    AND Patient.SEX = 'female'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS female_patient_count
FROM FilteredLabs;

WITH PatientCPKStatus AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    p.SEX,
    p.Birthday AS birthdate,
    MAX(l.CPK) AS max_CPK
  FROM Patient p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID
),
FilteredPatients AS (
  SELECT
    patient_id,
    SEX
  FROM PatientCPKStatus
  WHERE birthdate BETWEEN DATE('1936-01-01') AND DATE('1956-12-31')
    AND (max_CPK IS NULL OR max_CPK < 250)
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT), 1
  ) AS female_percentage
FROM FilteredPatients;

WITH FilteredLab AS (
  SELECT l.ID, l.Date, l.PLT, l."U-PRO", p.ID as PatientID, p.Birthday
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.Date >= '1981-01-01' AND l.Date <= '1986-12-31'
    AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
    AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND l."U-PRO" != ''
), AgeFiltered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PatientID
  FROM FilteredLab
  WHERE (
    CAST(strftime('%Y', Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)
    - (strftime('%m-%d', Date) < strftime('%m-%d', Birthday)) < 50
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM AgeFiltered
LIMIT 1000

WITH MoleculesWithSingleBond AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
OxygenAtomsPerMolecule AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS oxygen_count
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'O'
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
MoleculeOxygenStats AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COALESCE(o.oxygen_count, 0) AS oxygen_count
  FROM MoleculesWithSingleBond m
  LEFT JOIN OxygenAtomsPerMolecule o ON m.molecule_id = o.molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS avg_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule
FROM MoleculeOxygenStats;

WITH single_bonds AS (
  SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = 'single'
),
atoms_involved AS (
  SELECT atom_id FROM single_bonds
  UNION ALL
  SELECT atom_id2 FROM single_bonds
),
element_atoms AS (
  SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
  FROM atom a
  JOIN atoms_involved ai ON a.atom_id = ai.atom_id
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'I' THEN atom_id END) AS iodine_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'S' THEN atom_id END) AS sulfur_count
FROM element_atoms;

WITH BondCounts AS (
  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM bond b
  JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR010'
  GROUP BY bond_type
),
MostCommonBond AS (
  SELECT bond_type
  FROM BondCounts
  ORDER BY count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT mc.bond_type, 'NO' AS carcinogenic
FROM MostCommonBond mc;

WITH molecules_with_criteria AS (
    SELECT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = 'triple'
      AND a.element IN ('P', 'Br')
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
atoms_in_selected AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecules_with_criteria)
)
SELECT atom_count FROM atoms_in_selected;

WITH bond_summary AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
carcinogenic_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.label,
    b.total_bonds,
    b.single_bonds,
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond_summary b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.label, b.total_bonds, b.single_bonds
),
results AS (
  SELECT
    'all_single_bonds' AS group_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN count ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS diff
  FROM carcinogenic_counts
  WHERE total_bonds = single_bonds
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'other_bonds' AS group_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN count ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS diff
  FROM carcinogenic_counts
  WHERE total_bonds != single_bonds
)
SELECT * FROM results;

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label LIKE '%carcinogenic%'
), carbon_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'C'
), carbon_double_bonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_id
  FROM bond
  JOIN carcinogenic_molecules ON bond.molecule_id = carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id
  JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
  WHERE bond.bond_type = 'double'
  AND connected.atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM carbon_atoms)
  AND connected.atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM carbon_atoms)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) / 2 AS total_carbon_carbon_double_bonds
FROM carbon_double_bonds;

WITH chlorine_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'Cl'
), 
bonded_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CASE 
           WHEN atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM chlorine_atoms) THEN atom_id2 
           ELSE atom_id 
         END AS bonded_atom_id
  FROM connected
  WHERE (atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM chlorine_atoms) OR atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM chlorine_atoms))
    AND (atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM chlorine_atoms) OR atom_id2 NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM chlorine_atoms))
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bonded_atom_id) AS count_bonded_atoms_to_chlorine FROM bonded_atoms;

WITH sulfur_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id
    FROM atom a
    JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'S' AND m.label = '+'
), bonded_to_sulfur AS (
    SELECT c.atom_id2 AS bonded_atom
    FROM connected c
    JOIN sulfur_atoms s ON c.atom_id = s.atom_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.atom_id AS bonded_atom
    FROM connected c
    JOIN sulfur_atoms s ON c.atom_id2 = s.atom_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bonded_atom) AS count_directly_bonded_to_sulfur
FROM bonded_to_sulfur;

WITH nitrogen_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'N'
),
nitrogen_bonds AS (
  SELECT c.bond_id, na.atom_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN nitrogen_atoms na ON c.atom_id = na.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = na.atom_id
),
double_or_triple_nitrogen_bonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT nb.bond_id
  FROM nitrogen_bonds nb
  JOIN bond b ON nb.bond_id = b.bond_id
  WHERE b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
),
nitrogen_atoms_in_disallowed_bonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT nb.atom_id
  FROM nitrogen_bonds nb
  WHERE nb.bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM double_or_triple_nitrogen_bonds)
),
molecules_with_nitrogen AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM nitrogen_atoms
),
molecules_with_disallowed_nitrogen AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM nitrogen_atoms
  WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM nitrogen_atoms_in_disallowed_bonds)
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecules_with_nitrogen
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecules_with_disallowed_nitrogen);

WITH chlorine_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'cl'
),
chlorine_connections AS (
  SELECT atom_id, atom_id2
  FROM connected
  WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM chlorine_atoms) OR atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM chlorine_atoms)
),
bonded_atoms AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM chlorine_atoms) THEN atom_id2 ELSE atom_id END AS bonded_atom_id
  FROM chlorine_connections
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bonded_atom_id) AS atoms_bonded_to_chlorine
FROM bonded_atoms;

WITH ElementMoleculeCount AS (
  SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY element
),
RareElements AS (
  SELECT element
  FROM ElementMoleculeCount
  WHERE molecule_count = 1
),
RareElementAtoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, molecule_id, element
  FROM atom
  JOIN RareElements USING (element)
),
CarcinogenicMolecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE carcinogenic = 1
),
RareCarcinogenicMolecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM RareElementAtoms
  WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM CarcinogenicMolecules)
),
RareMoleculeAtoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, molecule_id
  FROM RareElementAtoms
  WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM RareCarcinogenicMolecules)
),
BondsInvolvingRareAtoms AS (
  SELECT c.bond_id, a1.molecule_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN RareMoleculeAtoms a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.bond_id, a2.molecule_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN RareMoleculeAtoms a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
BondCountsByMolecule AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM BondsInvolvingRareAtoms
  GROUP BY molecule_id
)
SELECT molecule_id, bond_count
FROM BondCountsByMolecule
ORDER BY molecule_id;

WITH MoleculeAtoms AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        atom_id,
        element
    FROM atom
),
CarbonAtoms AS (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS carbon_count
    FROM MoleculeAtoms
    WHERE element = 'C'
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
ChlorineAtoms AS (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS chlorine_count
    FROM MoleculeAtoms
    WHERE element = 'Cl'
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
AtomCount AS (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_atoms
    FROM MoleculeAtoms
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
BondWithElements AS (
    SELECT
        c.bond_id,
        a1.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS atom1_element,
        a2.element AS atom2_element,
        b.bond_type
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id AND b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
),
BondCounts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN atom1_element = 'C' OR atom2_element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type > '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM BondWithElements
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
Carcinogenicity AS (
    SELECT molecule_id, label AS carcinogenicity_label
    FROM molecule
)

SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bc.carbon_touching_bonds DESC, ac.total_atoms DESC, bc.molecule_id ASC) AS rank,
    bc.molecule_id,
    c.carcinogenicity_label,
    ac.total_atoms AS number_of_atoms,
    bc.total_bonds AS number_of_bonds,
    COALESCE(ca.carbon_count, 0) AS number_of_carbon_atoms,
    COALESCE(cla.chlorine_count, 0) AS number_of_chlorine_atoms,
    bc.carbon_touching_bonds AS number_of_carbon_touching_bonds,
    bc.multiple_bonds AS number_of_multiple_bonds
FROM BondCounts bc
JOIN AtomCount ac ON ac.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN CarbonAtoms ca ON ca.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN ChlorineAtoms cla ON cla.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
JOIN Carcinogenicity c ON c.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
WHERE COALESCE(ca.carbon_count, 0) > 0
ORDER BY
    bc.carbon_touching_bonds DESC,
    ac.total_atoms DESC,
    bc.molecule_id ASC
;

WITH molecule_with_yttrium AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'Y'
),
molecule_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule_with_yttrium)
),
molecule_bonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN molecule_atoms ma1 ON c.atom_id = ma1.atom_id
  JOIN molecule_atoms ma2 ON c.atom_id2 = ma2.atom_id
),
hydrogen_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'H'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS hydrogen_bond_count
FROM connected
WHERE bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM molecule_bonds)
  AND (atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM hydrogen_atoms) OR atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM hydrogen_atoms))
LIMIT 1000

WITH single_bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT c.atom_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  GROUP BY c.atom_id
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = 'single' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*)
     AND COUNT(*) > 0
)
SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS atoms_with_only_single_bonds
FROM atom a
JOIN single_bond_atoms sba ON a.atom_id = sba.atom_id
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element ASC;

WITH triple_bonds AS (
  SELECT bond.bond_id, bond.molecule_id, connected.atom_id
  FROM bond
  JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
  WHERE bond.bond_type = '3'
),
elements_in_triple_bonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT atom.element, triple_bonds.molecule_id
  FROM triple_bonds
  JOIN atom ON triple_bonds.atom_id = atom.atom_id
)
SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM elements_in_triple_bonds
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element ASC;
